title: HiMem-WAM: Hierarchical Memory-Gated World Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
tldr_zh: 分层潜动作WAM，联合学习运动与技能潜变量，并在预测的技能切换处由边界感知门控写入紧凑任务状态记忆。
tldr_en: A hierarchical world action model that jointly learns low-level motion and high-level skill latents, with a boundary-aware gate that writes compact task states to memory at predicted skill transitions.

title: MemoryWAM: Efficient World Action Modeling with Persistent Memory
tldr_zh: WAM混合记忆：近期帧、任务起始锚帧加每帧gist token压缩长程历史，以较低时延与显存支持记忆依赖操作。
tldr_en: A world action model with hybrid memory of recent frames, start-of-task anchor frames, and per-frame gist tokens summarizing older history, supporting memory-dependent manipulation at lower latency and GPU memory.

title: MemoryVAM: Integrating Memory into Video Action Model for Robot Manipulation
tldr_zh: 为视频动作模型加情景记忆：Perceiver把逐帧CLIP特征压成记忆token，门控估计任务进度，注入视频与动作分支。
tldr_en: Adds episodic memory to video world-model policies: a Perceiver compresses per-frame CLIP features into memory tokens that condition both the video backbone and the action decoder, while a light cue gate estimates task completion.

title: DIM-WAM: World-Action Modeling with Diverse Historical Event Memory
tldr_zh: 用多个并行事件记忆库从真实观测提取历史事件、按相似度合并冗余，并加进度监督，为WAM提供长程任务状态。
tldr_en: Gives world action models parallel event-memory banks that summarize real observations and merge redundant events by similarity, with progress supervision so memory tokens also encode the current task stage.

title: RM-WAM: Reliable Memory-Augmented World Action Models for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
tldr_zh: WAM结合短期视觉记忆与潜在事件记忆，用反事实替换历史来训练效用门控，按可靠性控制记忆注入。
tldr_en: Pairs short-term visual memory with latent event memory in a world action model, and trains a utility-aware gate on counterfactually varied histories to decide how much memory to inject.

title: OpenWAM: An Open, Modular Exploration Towards Systematic World-Action Model Pretraining
tldr_zh: 把WAM设计拆成可替换模块做受控实验，总结骨干、信息流与预训练数据的原则，并开源据此在约 6400 小时人类第一人称与机器人数据上预训练的 OpenWAM-α。
tldr_en: Factorizes world-action model design into swappable modules, runs controlled studies on backbones, information flow and pretraining data, and releases OpenWAM-α pretrained on about 6,400 hours of egocentric human and robot data.

title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
tldr_zh: 在12种机器人本体数据上训练JEPA潜空间世界模型，发现想象误差随算力服从二阶幂律，并可零样本按目标图规划。
tldr_en: Trains a JEPA latent world model on data from 12 robot embodiments, finds imagination error follows a second-order power law in compute, and plans zero-shot toward goal images on real robots.

title: AWAM: Active Trajectory-Conditioned View Imagination for Robust Robot Manipulation
tldr_zh: 主动世界动作模型：预测虚拟相机轨迹并想象沿途视图，压缩成固定记忆后与实时观测融合，以应对遮挡下的操作。
tldr_en: An active world-action model that predicts a task-related virtual camera path, imagines views along it, compresses them into a fixed memory and fuses it with live observations for occlusion-robust manipulation.

title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
tldr_zh: 扩展WAM的因果历史上下文，发现视频底座经自回归预训练时，长历史的收益远大于双向预训练；并以流式编码与异步执行满足实时控制。
tldr_en: Scales the causal context of world action models, showing longer history pays off far more with an autoregressively pretrained video backbone than with a bidirectional one, and adds streaming encoding and asynchronous execution for real-time control.

title: WorldScape Policy 2.0: Empowering Steerable World Action Modeling with Reasoning-Augmented Memory and In-Context Learning
tldr_zh: 可控WAM：把历史VLM输出组织成全局、当前活动与事件边界记忆供进度感知检索，生成隐式子目标，并构建近 500 万事件片段的预训练数据集 ManipEvent-5M。
tldr_en: A steerable world action model that organizes past VLM outputs into global, active and event-boundary memories for progress-aware retrieval, yielding implicit subgoals; pretrained on ManipEvent-5M, a dataset of nearly 5M event segments.

title: Memory as Plans: World-Action Modeling with Memory-Grounded Planning
tldr_zh: 把记忆交给规划器：用已完成子段的指令与稀疏帧记录生成下一段语言与视觉计划，执行器只看固定长度上下文并预测动作与进度，RMBench 成功率 83.3%。
tldr_en: Stores memory as records of completed segments (instructions plus sparse frames) and turns them into the next language and visual plan for a fixed-context executor that predicts actions and progress, reaching 83.3% success on RMBench.

title: LAW: Unifying Language, Action, and World Modeling for Agentic Physical Intelligence
tldr_zh: VLM与WAM闭环：VLM规划子任务、评估融合候选动作并判断进度，双路分层视觉记忆按子任务边界保留关键帧。
tldr_en: A closed-loop VLM–WAM framework where the VLM plans subtasks, scores and fuses proposed actions, and tracks progress, with dual-stream hierarchical visual memory keeping subtask-boundary frames in full detail.

title: WorldMark: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Interactive Video World Models
tldr_zh: 用逐模型适配器把统一的 WASD 指令转成各模型的控制格式，在 500 个用例上测动作响应、世界记忆与画质。
tldr_en: WorldMark maps a shared WASD vocabulary to each model's native controls via adapters and scores 500 cases on per-axis action response, world memory, and visual quality.

title: MBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark on Memory Capability for Video World Models
tldr_zh: MBench 把记忆分为实体、环境、因果三维 12 子项，用真实长视频加记忆触发指令，仅在模型确实执行触发时计分。
tldr_en: MBench splits video world model memory into entity, environment, and causal consistency (12 sub-dimensions) and probes real long videos with memory-triggering instructions, scoring a sample only when the trigger is actually executed.

title: OPIS: An Input-Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Object Memory in Video World Models
tldr_zh: OPIS 以首帧标注的物体实例为准，从存在、身份、结构三层评测视频世界模型的多物体记忆，含 500 个用例。
tldr_en: OPIS anchors evaluation to annotated object instances in the initial frame, scoring presence, identity, and structure of multi-object memory across 500 real, robotic, and game cases.

title: WorldMemBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Memory of Video World Models
tldr_zh: 用受控相机离开与多次回访，在 260 个用例上评测人物、物体、环境的静态记忆和视野外事件的动态记忆。
tldr_en: WorldMemBench uses controlled camera departures and repeated revisits over 260 cases to test static memory of people, objects, and environments, and dynamic memory of out-of-view events.

title: Out of Sight, Out of Mind? Evaluating State Evolution in Video World Models
tldr_zh: STEVO-Bench 用插入遮挡、关灯或移开相机打断观察，检验视频世界模型在看不见时能否让倒水、融化等过程继续演化。
tldr_en: STEVO-Bench interrupts observation with occluders, lights-off, or camera look-away to test whether video world models keep processes like pouring or melting evolving while unseen.

title: Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core
tldr_zh: WRBench 把相机运动当作可观测性干预，按执行、在场连续、返回一致逐级评测 23 个模型，发现返回的目标停在离开时的状态。
tldr_en: WRBench treats camera motion as an intervention on observability and scores execution, in-view continuity, and return consistency in sequence; across 23 models, returning targets reappear frozen in the state they were left in.

title: MemoBench: Benchmarking World Modeling in Dynamically Changing Environments
tldr_zh: MemoBench 用 360 段合成与真实片段构建消失–再现用例：目标在视野外发生物理变化，检验模型再现时能否给出更新后的状态。
tldr_en: MemoBench uses a disappear-and-reappear protocol in which a target changes physically while out of view, testing whether models recover its updated state, over 360 synthetic and real clips.

title: Evaluating Long-Term Memory in 3D Mazes
tldr_zh: 提出随机 3D 迷宫 Memory Maze，配在线强化学习、离线数据集和探针任务，单独检验智能体能否记住物体位置与迷宫布局。
tldr_en: Introduces Memory Maze, randomized 3D mazes with an online RL benchmark, offline dataset and probing tasks that isolate whether agents remember object locations and maze layout.

title: LoopNav: Benchmarking Spatial Consistency in World Models
tldr_zh: 在 Minecraft 采集 250 小时带动作的回环导航视频，用场景图一致性分数评估世界模型回到原处时的空间一致性。
tldr_en: Collects 250 hours of action-labelled loop-navigation videos in Minecraft and proposes a scene-graph consistency score to test whether world models stay spatially consistent when returning to a location.

title: MIND: Benchmarking Memory Consistency and Action Control in World Models
tldr_zh: MIND 提供第一/第三人称、多种动作空间下的 250 段闭环重访视频，评测世界模型的记忆一致性与动作控制，并给出基线。
tldr_en: MIND offers 250 first- and third-person closed-loop revisit videos across varied action spaces to score memory consistency and action control in world models, with a MIND-World baseline.

title: iWorld-Bench: A Benchmark for Interactive World Models with a Unified Action Generation Framework
tldr_zh: 用动作生成框架统一不同交互方式，设计 6 类共 4.9k 个测试样本，评测 14 个世界模型的画质、轨迹跟随和往返回访记忆。
tldr_en: iWorld-Bench uses an action generation framework to unify differing interaction modalities, then evaluates 14 world models on 4.9k test samples across six task types covering visual quality, trajectory following, and memory.

title: WBench: A Comprehensive Multi-turn Benchmark for Interactive Video World Model Evaluation
tldr_zh: WBench 以 289 个多轮交互用例和 22 个子指标，从画质、设定遵循、交互遵循、一致性和物理五维评测交互视频世界模型。
tldr_en: WBench evaluates interactive video world models on 289 multi-turn cases with 22 sub-metrics across quality, setting adherence, interaction adherence, consistency, and physics.

title: WorldRoamBench: An Open-World Benchmark for Long-Horizon Stability of Interactive World Models
tldr_zh: 用千余个 10–60 秒连续操控用例，从动作、视觉漂移、物理和记忆四维评测交互世界模型的长程稳定性。
tldr_en: WorldRoamBench tests long-horizon stability of interactive world models over 1,000+ cases of 10–60 s WASD control, covering per-frame action, drift, physics, and trajectory-aware scene and subject memory.

title: R2M-Bench: Evaluating Revisit Memory via Relative Consistency in Interactive Video World Models
tldr_zh: R2M-Bench 把每次回访与同一 rollout 中等间隔非回访对和短程对比较，得到相对记忆分，排除画面变化少带来的虚高。
tldr_en: R2M-Bench compares each revisit pair with gap-matched non-revisit and short-range pairs from the same rollout, yielding relative memory scores that discount the slow-motion shortcut.

title: On Memory: A comparison of memory mechanisms in world models
tldr_zh: 在 MemoryMaze 上用状态回忆任务，对比 Transformer 世界模型中 4 种记忆编码与 5 种注入方式的 20 种组合，mLSTM 编码配加性注入的回忆效果最好。
tldr_en: Benchmarks 20 combinations of four memory encoders and five injection methods for transformer world models on MemoryMaze state recall, finding that an mLSTM encoder with additive injection recalls best.

title: Echo-Memory: A Controlled Study of Memory in Action World Models
tldr_zh: 固定骨干、训练与评测，只换记忆模块，对比原始上下文、压缩、空间摘要与状态空间递归，发现回放画质不能代表回访记忆。
tldr_en: Holds backbone, training, and evaluation fixed while swapping only the memory module, comparing raw context, compression, spatial summaries, and state-space recurrence; replay fidelity fails to predict return-visit memory.

title: Execution Before Memory: Diagnosing Memory Failures in Video World Models
tldr_zh: 提出 MIST，把场景建立、变化执行、结果呈现分开计分，发现记忆失败多因指令没执行，并用改写指令的 M3-Agent 补救。
tldr_en: MIST scores scene setup, execution of the hidden change, and the revealed result separately, showing many apparent memory failures are unexecuted instructions; M3-Agent rewrites failed instructions to restore execution.

title: LiveWorld: Simulating Out-of-Sight Dynamics in Generative Video World Models
tldr_zh: 针对物体离开视野后状态被冻结，维护静态 3D 背景加持续演化的动态实体，用监视器模拟视野外进展并在回访时同步，并提出评测基准 LiveBench。
tldr_en: Addresses objects freezing once out of view by keeping a static 3D background plus dynamic entities whose states a monitor keeps evolving off-screen and syncs on revisit; introduces LiveBench.

title: GEN3C: 3D-Informed World-Consistent Video Generation with Precise Camera Control
tldr_zh: 用预测深度把输入或已生成帧升为点云 3D 缓存，沿用户相机轨迹渲染作条件生成，实现精确相机控制与 3D 一致。
tldr_en: Lifts seed or previously generated frames into a point-cloud 3D cache via predicted depth and conditions generation on its renderings along the user camera path, giving precise camera control and 3D consistency.

title: Latent Spatial Memory for Video World Models
tldr_zh: 把场景记忆存为扩散潜空间的 3D 缓存：按深度反投影潜变量建图、在潜空间直接变换出新视角，免去像素渲染与重编码。
tldr_en: Stores scene memory as a 3D cache in diffusion latent space: latent tokens are lifted by depth back-projection and queried by direct latent warping, avoiding pixel-space rendering and re-encoding.

title: MoVerse: Real-Time Video World Modeling with Panoramic Gaussian Scaffold
tldr_zh: 把窄视场单图扩成 360° 全景并提升为持久 3D 高斯骨架作空间记忆，再由高斯条件渲染器沿相机轨迹实时生成视频。
tldr_en: Expands a single narrow-view image into a 360° panorama, lifts it into a persistent 3D Gaussian scaffold as spatial memory, and renders video from it with a Gaussian-conditioned renderer distilled for real-time streaming.

title: 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling
tldr_zh: 构建 4D 潜在缓存，把多种编码器表征绑定到共享几何与运动，可按任意时间与视角直接读取作条件，免去渲染与重编码。
tldr_en: A 4D latent cache that binds features from multiple encoders (e.g., VAE, DINO) to shared geometry and motion and can be read at arbitrary times and viewpoints as generation conditions, avoiding per-request rendering and re-encoding.

title: Persistent Planar Memory for Video World Models
tldr_zh: 以平面图元作持久 3D 记忆：每个自回归块同时预测 RGB 与平面几何并合并进平面记忆，再经渲染深度条件后续生成，比逐像素点云紧凑约三个数量级。
tldr_en: Uses plane primitives as persistent 3D memory: each chunk also predicts planar geometry that is merged into a plane map, which conditions later chunks via rendered depth and is three orders of magnitude more compact than per-pixel point clouds.

title: DeepVerse: 4D Autoregressive Video Generation as a World Model
tldr_zh: 让 4D 交互世界模型同时预测几何，并把以往时刻的几何预测纳入当前动作条件预测，减轻漂移并支持几何感知的记忆检索。
tldr_en: A 4D interactive world model that predicts geometry alongside frames and feeds earlier geometric predictions into current action-conditioned prediction, reducing drift and enabling geometry-aware memory retrieval.

title: Voyager: Long-Range and World-Consistent Video Diffusion for Explorable 3D Scene Generation
tldr_zh: 联合生成对齐的 RGB 与深度视频，维护带点剔除的点云世界缓存自回归扩展，从单图生成可沿自定义轨迹探索的 3D 场景。
tldr_en: Jointly generates aligned RGB and depth video conditioned on a culled, incrementally updated point-cloud world cache, autoregressively extending explorable 3D scenes from a single image along user camera paths.

title: Video World Models with Long-term Spatial Memory
tldr_zh: 把生成帧重建并融合成只含静态部分的 TSDF 点云作长期空间记忆，沿目标轨迹渲染作条件，配合近期帧工作记忆和稀疏关键帧情景记忆，缓解回访时的场景遗忘。
tldr_en: Fuses generated frames into a static-only TSDF point-cloud memory rendered along the target path as conditioning, combined with recent-frame working memory and sparse keyframe episodic memory, reducing forgetting on revisits.

title: EvoWorld: Evolving Panoramic World Generation with Explicit 3D Memory
tldr_zh: 从单张全景图出发，交替生成全景视频并用前馈模型更新 3D 重建，再以其在目标视角的重投影作条件，保持长程探索的空间一致，并提出侧重回环的探索基准。
tldr_en: From a single panorama, alternates panoramic video generation with feed-forward updates of a 3D reconstruction and conditions future frames on its reprojections for spatially consistent long-range exploration; introduces a loop-closure exploration benchmark.

title: Spatia: Video Generation with Updatable Spatial Memory
tldr_zh: 以 3D 场景点云作持久空间记忆，逐段生成视频并用视觉 SLAM 持续更新，动静分离以兼顾空间一致与动态实体生成。
tldr_en: Keeps a 3D scene point cloud as persistent spatial memory, generates clips conditioned on it and updates it with visual SLAM, separating static scene from dynamic entities.

title: AnchorWeave: World-Consistent Video Generation with Retrieved Local Spatial Memories
tldr_zh: 用多个干净的局部几何记忆替代易错位的全局重建，按目标轨迹覆盖度检索局部记忆，并由多锚编织控制器调和跨视角不一致。
tldr_en: Replaces one misaligned global reconstruction with multiple local geometric memories, retrieves them by coverage along the target trajectory, and fuses them via a multi-anchor weaving controller reconciling cross-view inconsistencies.

title: WorldStereo: Bridging Camera-Guided Video Generation and Scene Reconstruction via 3D Geometric Memories
tldr_zh: 以增量更新的点云全局记忆给出相机控制与结构先验，以空间立体记忆按 3D 对应约束注意力取细节，连接视频生成与重建。
tldr_en: Connects camera-guided video generation and 3D reconstruction through two geometric memories: an incrementally updated point cloud for camera control and coarse structure, and a spatial-stereo memory that restricts attention using 3D correspondences.

title: Beyond Pixel Histories: World Models with Persistent 3D State
tldr_zh: 让世界模型模拟潜在 3D 场景（环境、相机、渲染器）的演化，由持久 3D 状态合成新帧，并支持在 3D 中编辑环境。
tldr_en: Simulates the evolution of a latent 3D scene—environment, camera and renderer—so new frames come from a persistent 3D state, enabling consistent geometry and direct 3D editing of interactive worlds.

title: Space-Aware World Models: Spatial Persistence Through Factored Scene Representations
authors: Bruno Corcuera, Carlos Eiras-Franco, Brais Cancela
tldr_zh: 把导航仿真分解为每回合从俯视地图推断一次的场景潜码、显式的动作条件智能体状态和渲染器，以提升回访时地标与几何的一致性。
tldr_en: Factors navigation world modeling into a per-episode scene latent inferred from a top-down map, an explicit action-conditioned agent state, and a renderer, improving landmark and geometric consistency on revisits.

title: Infinite-World: Scaling Interactive World Models to 1000-Frame Horizons via Pose-Free Hierarchical Memory
tldr_zh: 用与生成器联合训练的分层无位姿压缩器把历史潜变量递归蒸馏为定额表示，配合不确定性动作标注和回访密集微调，支撑千帧级交互。
tldr_en: Targets 1000-frame interaction on real videos with a pose-free hierarchical compressor that recursively distills past latents into a fixed budget and is trained jointly with the generator, plus uncertainty-aware action labels and revisit-dense finetuning.

title: Out of Sight but Not Out of Mind: Hybrid Memory for Dynamic Video World Models
tldr_zh: 针对动态主体出视野再出现时冻结或消失，把记忆压缩成 token，按时空相关性检索运动线索以保持其身份与运动，并构建含出入视野事件的 HM-World 数据集。
tldr_en: Targets dynamic subjects that leave and re-enter the view, compressing memory into tokens and retrieving motion cues by spatiotemporal relevance; also releases HM-World, a dataset with designed exit-entry events.

title: Geometry-Aware Implicit Memory for Video World Models
tldr_zh: 用轻量编码器把变长历史压成定长记忆 token，训练时经可按相机查询的几何头从冻结基础模型蒸馏 3D 结构，并用信息引导剪枝限制编码开销。
tldr_en: Compresses variable-length history into fixed-size memory tokens with a lightweight encoder, distills 3D structure into them via a camera-queryable geometry head during training, and bounds cost with information-guided pruning.

title: Compression and Retrieval: Implicit Memory Retrieval for Video World Models
tldr_zh: 用轻量上下文压缩网络压缩历史，经位置编码注入视角信息、以注意力计算隐式检索记忆，并构建 SceneFly 合成数据集。
tldr_en: Compresses long context with a lightweight network and retrieves memory implicitly through attention, with viewpoint injected via positional encoding; also builds the SceneFly synthetic dataset with realistic camera trajectories.

title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
tldr_zh: 由目标视角决定如何压缩多视角历史：联合训练的记忆编码器与位姿条件读出模块把历史整合为一组目标视角专属 token。
tldr_en: Lets the requested viewpoint shape compression: a jointly trained memory encoder and pose-conditioned readout fuse past observations into a fixed set of target-view tokens before denoising, without explicit depth correspondences.

title: RELIC: Interactive Video World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
tldr_zh: 在 KV 缓存中用高度压缩、编码相对动作与绝对相机位姿的历史潜变量 token 作长时记忆，并经省内存自强迫蒸馏得到 14B、16 FPS 的实时交互模型。
tldr_en: Stores long-horizon memory as highly compressed historical latent tokens with relative-action and absolute-pose encoding in the KV cache, and distills a 14B real-time (16 FPS) interactive model via memory-efficient self-forcing.

title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
tldr_zh: 免训练：存下被驱逐的 KV 块，按相机/动作对应取回放回注意力窗口，并按键相似度剪除冗余 token 以省存储，以约 2 倍吞吐达到或超过全 KV 的记忆保真。
tldr_en: A training-free method that offloads evicted KV chunks, retrieves scene-relevant ones back into the attention window by camera/action correspondence, and prunes redundant tokens by key similarity, matching full-KV memory fidelity at about 2x throughput.

title: DecMem: Towards Minute-Long Consistent World Generation with Decoupled Memory
tldr_zh: 针对可学习记忆长程外推时的计算低效与注意力分散，用稀疏全局记忆按块 top-k 访问历史，再与锚定局部滑窗记忆门控融合。
tldr_en: Diagnoses inefficiency and attention dispersion in learnable memory for long extrapolation, and decouples it into a sparse global memory for fine-grained access to history and an anchored local memory for stable generation.

title: Addressable Memory for Video World Models
tldr_zh: 针对超出训练时长后时间 RoPE 偏移越界、KV 缓存难以寻址，免训练地给压缩摘要槽分配分布内的虚拟位置，并提出长绕路后回访的评测 LoopBench。
tldr_en: Shows that KV-cache content becomes unaddressable once temporal RoPE offsets exceed the training range, and fixes this without training by giving each compressed summary slot an in-distribution virtual position; also introduces LoopBench.

title: Mastering Memory Tasks with World Models
tldr_zh: 把状态空间模型融入 DreamerV3 式世界模型（R2I），增强强化学习智能体的长期记忆与长程信用分配。
tldr_en: Integrates state-space models into a DreamerV3-style world model (R2I) to improve long-term memory and credit assignment for RL agents, evaluated on memory tasks such as BSuite, POPGym and Memory Maze.

title: Long-Context State-Space Video World Models
tldr_zh: 用分块 SSM 扫描延长时间记忆，配合稠密局部注意保证相邻帧连贯，使视频世界模型以可接受的推理成本保留长程空间记忆。
tldr_en: Extends temporal memory of video world models with block-wise state-space scanning plus dense local attention for frame-to-frame coherence, evaluated with spatial retrieval tasks on Memory Maze and Minecraft.

title: StateSpaceDiffuser: Bringing Long Context to Diffusion World Models
tldr_zh: 用状态空间模型概括整段交互历史并将其特征注入扩散世界模型，弥补只看少量近期帧导致的遗忘，并提出重现已见内容的评测协议。
tldr_en: Feeds features from a state-space model summarizing the full interaction history into a diffusion world model to restore long-term context, and proposes an evaluation protocol for re-instantiating previously seen content.

title: Recurrent Autoregressive Diffusion: Global Memory Meets Local Attention
tldr_zh: 在每个 DiT 层注意力后加 LSTM 等循环层作定长全局记忆，配合重叠滑窗全注意保留局部细节，并消除训练推理差异。
tldr_en: Adds recurrent layers (e.g., LSTM) after attention in each DiT block as a fixed-size global memory, with full attention over overlapping sliding windows for local detail and no train-inference gap.

title: Flow Equivariant World Models: Memory for Partially Observed Dynamic Environments
tldr_zh: 让潜在记忆随自身运动和推断的物体运动等变地平移变换，使视野外区域的信息随时间保持对齐，用于部分可观测动态环境的长程预测。
tldr_en: Builds a latent memory that shifts equivariantly with self-motion and inferred object motion, keeping out-of-view information aligned over time for long-horizon prediction in partially observed dynamic environments.

title: LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models
tldr_zh: 一半网络块保留历史 KV，另一半用读写受相机投影几何调制的递归线性注意记忆，兼顾细节保留与有界显存。
tldr_en: Keeps a KV cache in half of the transformer blocks and, in the other half, a recurrent linear-attention memory whose reads and writes are conditioned on projective camera geometry, balancing detail and bounded memory.

title: Learning to Retrieve: Internalizing Memory Retrieval for Video World Models
tldr_zh: 把部分自注意力换成门控线性注意、以其递归状态作记忆，相机条件门决定取什么，受重新可见信号监督的触发器决定何时取。
tldr_en: Internalizes memory retrieval by reusing the model's persistent internal state as memory, with a camera-conditioned gate deciding what to retrieve and a trigger, supervised by 3D re-visibility, deciding when.

title: Teaching Video Generators to Remember: Eliciting Dynamic Memory for Out-of-Sight State Evolution
tldr_zh: ReMind 用记忆导向数据、事件感知课程和相机相位 RoPE，训练视频生成器跨越观察中断从 KV 缓存取回视野外状态。
tldr_en: ReMind trains video generators to retrieve out-of-sight states from the KV cache across interruptions, using memory-oriented data, an event-aware curriculum (node-drop, noisy memory), and camera-phase PM-RoPE.

title: Memory Forcing: Spatio-Temporal Memory for Consistent Scene Generation on Minecraft
tldr_zh: 用点云回溯源帧的几何索引空间记忆，配合混合训练与链式前向训练，让模型探索时靠近期帧、回访时用空间记忆。
tldr_en: Pairs geometry-indexed spatial memory (point-to-frame retrieval over an incremental 3D cache) with hybrid and chained-forward training, so a Minecraft world model relies on recent frames when exploring and spatial memory when revisiting.

title: Training Object Permanence in World Models
tldr_zh: 人工设计 150 个认知科学启发任务，用 Blender 随机化渲染出 150 万样本的物体恒存训练集和 300 题测试，并训练 16B 世界模型。
tldr_en: Introduces WROP, 150 cognitive-science-inspired object-permanence tasks whose Blender generators randomize nuisance factors, releasing a 1.5M-sample training corpus and a 300-question exam, and trains a 16B video world model on it.

title: Robust Dreamer: Deviation-Aware Latent Gaussian Memory for Action-Controlled AR Video Generation
tldr_zh: 把扩散潜变量挂到高斯基元上做潜空间泼溅记忆，训练时注入按阶段和时间步存档的模型偏差，让生成器学会从带误差记忆中纠正。
tldr_en: Stores diffusion latents on Gaussian primitives recalled by latent splatting, and injects archived model-induced deviations into memory during training so the generator learns to correct corrupted history.

title: Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips
tldr_zh: 在模型自展开的 rollout 上用潜变量与感知统计的 Fréchet 距离约束场景保真与真实感，并加锚定流匹配；只用短片段微调，超过 4000 帧仍保持稳定。
tldr_en: Fine-tunes a streaming world model on its own free rollouts with Fréchet-distance losses on latent and perceptual statistics plus anchored flow matching, staying stable beyond 4,000 frames using only short clips.

title: WorldPack: Dynamic Frame Compression for Long-context Video World Modeling
tldr_zh: 按与当前视锥的 3D 重叠给历史帧打分，相关帧少压缩、无关帧多压缩，在 4 帧预算内放入 22 帧历史，改善回访一致性。
tldr_en: Scores past frames by field-of-view overlap with the current camera and compresses less relevant ones more, packing 22 history frames into a 4-frame budget to improve revisit consistency in navigation world models.

title: Spatial Memory Intelligence: Endowing World Models with Understanding-Driven Long-Term Memory
tldr_zh: 用微调的多模态大模型管理空间记忆：聚类、簇内稀疏化、动作感知检索和可靠性过滤，删去八成以上记忆仍改善回访一致性。
tldr_en: Uses a fine-tuned multimodal LLM to manage a world model's spatial memory through clustering, within-cluster sparsification, action-aware retrieval, and reliability filtering, yielding sparser memory and better spatial consistency.

title: StableWorld: Towards Stable and Consistent Long Interactive Video Generation
tldr_zh: 免训练的滑动窗口帧驱逐：用 ORB 几何相似度剔除同一场景中已漂移的冗余中间帧，保留干净早期帧，抑制长程误差累积。
tldr_en: A frame-eviction rule for the sliding context window that uses ORB-based geometric consistency to drop redundant, possibly drifted intermediate frames while keeping clean early ones, curbing error accumulation in long interactive video generation.

title: Building spatial world models from sparse transitional episodic memories
tldr_zh: 受认知地图启发，从稀疏、不连续的情景转移记忆构建空间世界模型，预测未观测转移，免训练支持探索与导航。
tldr_en: Inspired by cognitive maps, ESWM builds a spatial world model from sparse, disjoint episodic transition memories, predicting unobserved transitions and supporting exploration and navigation without extra training.

title: NavMorph: A Self-Evolving World Model for Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
tldr_zh: VLN-CE中用RSSM潜空间世界模型前瞻想象，并以跨回合持续更新的上下文演化记忆检索场景信息，实现在线自适应。
tldr_en: A self-evolving world model for continuous-environment VLN that imagines ahead with an RSSM-style latent model and adapts online using a Contextual Evolution Memory of scene context.

title: Dream to Recall: Imagination-Guided Experience Retrieval for Memory-Persistent Vision-and-Language Navigation
tldr_zh: 记忆持续型VLN中，用世界模型想象的未来状态作查询，从按视点锚定的观测与行为记忆中检索经验，IR2R上SPL提升5.4。
tldr_en: In memory-persistent VLN, a world model's imagined future states serve as queries to retrieve observations and past behaviors from a viewpoint-anchored memory, gaining 5.4 SPL on IR2R.

title: Pathdreamer: A World Model for Indoor Navigation
tldr_zh: 为室内导航构建视觉世界模型，从已有观测生成未访问视点的360°RGB、语义与深度，用于VLN前瞻规划。
tldr_en: A visual world model for indoor navigation that generates 360° RGB, semantics and depth at unvisited viewpoints from prior observations, used for lookahead planning in VLN.

title: DREAMWALKER: Mental Planning for Continuous Vision-Language Navigation
tldr_zh: 面向连续环境VLN，把视觉、拓扑与动态压缩成离散结构化世界模型，先在其中模拟评估计划再执行。
tldr_en: A VLN-CE agent whose world model summarizes visual, topological, and dynamic cues into a discrete, structured representation, letting it evaluate candidate plans by mental simulation before acting.

title: Lookahead Exploration with Neural Radiance Representation for Continuous Vision-Language Navigation
tldr_zh: 针对VLN-CE前瞻时预测RGB失真且昂贵，用预训练分层神经辐射表示预测候选位置的语义特征，再建路径树选路。
tldr_en: Instead of predicting distorted, costly RGB for lookahead in VLN-CE, a pretrained hierarchical neural radiance model predicts semantic features at candidate locations to build and score a future path tree.

title: Navigation World Models
tldr_zh: 用10亿参数条件扩散Transformer按过去帧和导航动作预测未来画面，通过模拟轨迹规划或给外部策略的轨迹排序。
tldr_en: A 1B-parameter conditional diffusion transformer predicts future frames from past frames and navigation actions, planning by simulating trajectories or ranking those sampled from an external policy.

title: Schrödinger's Navigator: Imagining an Ensemble of Futures for Zero-Shot Object Navigation
tldr_zh: 零样本目标导航中，用轨迹条件3D世界模型想象多种可能的未来场景，汇总成未来感知价值地图来选更稳健的路径点。
tldr_en: For zero-shot object navigation under occlusion, a trajectory-conditioned 3D world model imagines multiple plausible futures and aggregates them into a future-aware value map for risk-aware waypoint selection.

title: WorldMAP: Bootstrapping Vision-Language Navigation Trajectory Prediction with Generative World Models
tldr_zh: 把世界模型生成的未来视频转成语义-空间记忆和规划伪标签，蒸馏给轻量学生模型直接预测导航轨迹。
tldr_en: Turns world-model-generated future videos into semantic-spatial memory and planning-derived pseudo-labels, then trains a lightweight student to predict navigation trajectories directly from vision-language input.

title: WMNav: Integrating Vision-Language Models into World Models for Object Goal Navigation
tldr_zh: 用VLM构建零样本目标导航世界模型，预测决策结果并在线维护好奇心价值地图作为记忆，配合两阶段动作提议。
tldr_en: Builds a zero-shot object-navigation world model on VLMs that predicts decision outcomes and keeps an online Curiosity Value Map as memory, with a two-stage explore-then-localize action proposer.

title: Learning 3D Persistent Embodied World Models
tldr_zh: 针对视频世界模型缺乏视野外记忆，把生成的RGB-D聚合成持久3D地图，并以此为条件生成后续画面以支撑长程规划。
tldr_en: Gives a video world model explicit memory by aggregating its generated RGB-D frames into a persistent 3D map and conditioning further generation on it, enabling consistent long-horizon simulation and planning.

title: 3D-Belief: Embodied Belief Inference via Generative 3D World Modeling
tldr_zh: 把世界建模视为3D信念推断，从部分观测推出显式3D场景信念并在线更新，可采样多种补全，用于目标导航。
tldr_en: Frames world modeling as embodied belief inference: infers explicit 3D beliefs about unobserved space from partial observations, updates them online, and samples multiple completions for object navigation.

title: GLAM: Training a latent world model over global spatiotemporal memory for active exploration and navigation
tldr_zh: 在全局时空地图记忆上训练JEPA式潜空间世界模型，联合预测未来地图特征与路径点，用于目标导航与主动探索。
tldr_en: A JEPA-style latent world model that, given historical map tokens, a goal, and the robot pose, jointly predicts future map tokens and waypoint latents for object navigation and active exploration.

title: World SLAM Model: Joint World Modeling for SLAM and Navigation
tldr_zh: 把SLAM的增量状态更新与后端修正引入导航世界模型，预测未来画面时同时估计位姿与稠密几何，维护持久空间状态。
tldr_en: Brings SLAM-style incremental state updates and backend refinement into a navigation world model, predicting future views with camera motion and dense geometry to maintain a persistent spatial state.

title: G$^2$WAM: World Action Models for Efficient and Geometry Grounded Image-Goal Navigation
tldr_zh: 图像目标导航中用场景坐标定位把当前、目标与历史帧锚到同一坐标系，在潜空间联合预测未来状态与动作，免去CEM规划。
tldr_en: A world action model for image-goal navigation that anchors current, goal, and history frames in a shared scene-coordinate frame and jointly predicts latent future states and actions, avoiding CEM planning and pixel reconstruction.

title: Towards Unified World Models for Visual Navigation via Memory-Augmented Planning and Foresight
tldr_zh: 在单一多模态自回归骨干中统一视觉预见与导航规划，用分层记忆融合短期感知与长期轨迹上下文。
tldr_en: Unifies egocentric visual foresight and navigation planning in one multimodal autoregressive backbone, with a hierarchical memory fusing short-term perceptual cues and longer-term trajectory context.

title: Visual Representation and History Modeling for Navigation World Models
tldr_zh: 研究导航世界模型的表征与历史建模，提出可复用历史的Cached-Linear注意力及带帧级循环记忆的GDN。
tldr_en: Compares five frozen visual representations for navigation world models and proposes Cached-Linear, a hybrid attention that reuses history across planning queries, and Balanced GDN, which adds frame-wise recurrent memory.

title: Towards Memory-Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation via Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption
tldr_zh: 把部分层从全注意改为局部注意，闭式求解最小二乘得到实例专属权重调制以吸收丢弃的历史 KV，最多去掉一半 KV 缓存而画质近乎无损。
tldr_en: Switches some layers to local attention and compensates for the dropped history with an instance-specific weight modulation solved by closed-form least squares, removing up to 50% of the KV cache with near-lossless quality.

title: World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models
tldr_zh: 在每个 DiT 层加测试时训练记忆：用递归最小二乘按位姿键把挤出窗口的特征写入快权重，再按目标位姿读出。
tldr_en: Adds a test-time-training memory to each DiT layer that consolidates past observations into fast weights through pose-keyed recursive least-squares updates and reads them out by camera pose, enabling real-time generation with constant storage.

title: SlowFast-VGen: Slow-Fast Learning for Action-Driven Long Video Generation
tldr_zh: 慢学习预训练动作条件视频扩散模型，推理时快学习用局部输入输出更新时序 LoRA 存储情景记忆，并以慢快学习循环结合二者。
tldr_en: Pairs slow pretraining of an action-conditioned video diffusion model with inference-time fast learning that updates a temporal LoRA to store episodic memory, combined through a slow-fast learning loop.

title: Composition of Memory Experts for Diffusion World Models
tldr_zh: 以对比式专家乘积组合短期、长期与空间三类记忆专家，其中长期专家经轻量测试时微调把情景历史存入独立扩散模型权重。
tldr_en: Combines short-term, long-term and spatial memory experts via a contrastive product of experts; the long-term expert stores episodic history in separate diffusion weights through lightweight test-time finetuning.

title: MemLearner: Learning to Query Context memory for Video World Models
tldr_zh: 针对规则检索在遮挡和动态物体下失效，在历史与目标 token 间插入可学习查询 token，让生成模型学会取相关上下文。
tldr_en: Replaces rule-based frame retrieval with learnable query tokens placed between context and target tokens, letting the video model itself learn which history to extract, targeting occlusions and dynamic objects.

title: Learning What to Recall: Adaptive Multi-Cue Episodic Memory for World Models
tldr_zh: 用回忆内容下真实未来的预测似然（以负扩散损失近似）训练检索器，按查询自适应决定信任时间、位姿、视觉、音频等哪类线索。
tldr_en: Trains an episodic-memory retriever with future-aware supervision (negative diffusion loss of the realized future given recalled context), learning per query which cues—time, pose, vision, audio—to trust.

title: Geometry-Aware Rotary Position Embedding for Consistent Video World Model
tldr_zh: 把屏幕空间位置编码换成注入相机射线方向的几何感知 RoPE，并按几何线索稀疏关注相关历史帧，减轻回访时的几何漂移，并提出诊断套件 ViewBench。
tldr_en: Replaces screen-space positional embeddings with rotary embeddings built from camera-ray geometry, plus geometry-guided frame-sparse attention over history, to reduce drift on camera revisits; introduces the ViewBench diagnostic suite.

title: UCM: Unified Modeling of Camera Control and Memory with Time-aware Positional Encoding Warping for World Models
tldr_zh: 用时间感知的位置编码变换把历史帧对齐到目标相机，统一长期记忆与相机控制，并用点云渲染模拟回访来构造大规模训练数据。
tldr_en: Unifies long-term memory and camera control by warping time-aware positional encodings to align historical frames with the target camera, trained on revisits simulated by point-cloud rendering of monocular videos.

title: MosaicMem: Hybrid Spatial Memory for Controllable Video World Models
tldr_zh: 把图像块提升到 3D 定位并按目标视角取回，拼成与查询视角对齐的块马赛克作条件，保留应持续的内容、让模型补全变化部分。
tldr_en: Lifts image patches into 3D, retrieves those visible from the queried view, and composes them into a view-aligned mosaic as conditioning, keeping persistent content while letting the model inpaint what changes.

title: I3DM: Implicit 3D-aware Memory Retrieval and Injection for Consistent Video Scene Generation
tldr_zh: 借前馈新视角合成模型的特征给历史帧打分检索，再将其隐式对齐到目标视角并按可靠区域注入，改善遮挡下的回访一致性。
tldr_en: Scores past frames with features from a feed-forward novel-view-synthesis model for occlusion-robust retrieval, then implicitly warps them to the target view and injects reliable regions, without explicit 3D reconstruction.

title: Lyra 2.0: Explorable Generative 3D Worlds
tldr_zh: 保存逐帧几何，仅用于检索相关历史帧并建立与目标视角的稠密对应；配合自增强历史训练抑制漂移，生成可重建为 3D 的长视频。
tldr_en: Keeps per-frame geometry only to retrieve relevant past frames and build dense correspondences to the target view, and trains on self-degraded histories to curb drift, yielding long videos reconstructable into 3D worlds.

title: Memorize When Needed: Decoupled Memory Control for Spatially Consistent Long-Horizon Video Generation
tldr_zh: 把记忆条件解耦为独立轻量分支，每帧经交叉注意只接收空间相关的历史信息，并用相机感知门控仅在有可用历史时启用记忆。
tldr_en: Decouples memory from generation with a lightweight branch: per-frame cross-attention conditions each frame only on spatially relevant history, and a camera-aware gate enables memory only when meaningful references exist.

title: Matrix-Game 3.5: Enhancing Real-Time Streaming Interactive World Models with Patch Memory
tldr_zh: 以潜变量块为记忆单元，按深度重投影到目标视角并用平铺 PRoPE 编码相机，静动态分离建模，并蒸馏成实时因果生成器。
tldr_en: Stores memory as latent patches reprojected by depth into the target view, combined with tiled PRoPE camera encoding and static-dynamic disentanglement, then distills to a real-time causal generator.

title: WorldMem: Long-term Consistent World Simulation with Memory
tldr_zh: 针对长时世界模拟中回访不一致，维护带位姿和时间戳的历史帧记忆库，用按状态的记忆注意力取回相关帧以重建先前场景。
tldr_en: Keeps a memory bank of past frames tagged with pose and timestamp, and uses state-aware memory attention to recall relevant frames so revisited scenes stay consistent in long simulations.

title: VRAG: Learning World Models for Interactive Video Generation
tldr_zh: 为图生视频模型加入动作与全局状态条件，按智能体位置与朝向的相似度检索历史帧作上下文，减轻长程误差累积，并给出评测基准。
tldr_en: Adds action conditioning and explicit global-state conditioning to an autoregressive image-to-video model and retrieves past frames as context, reducing long-term compounding error; also provides a world-model benchmark.

title: Context as Memory: Scene-Consistent Interactive Long Video Generation with Memory Retrieval
tldr_zh: 把历史帧直接当记忆，按相机视场重叠挑选相关帧，沿帧维与待生成帧拼接作条件，提升交互式长视频的场景一致性。
tldr_en: Stores raw past frames as memory, retrieves those whose camera field of view overlaps the target view, and concatenates them with the frames to be generated, improving scene consistency in interactive long videos.

title: VMem: Consistent Interactive Video Scene Generation with Surfel-Indexed View Memory
tldr_zh: 用 3D 面元为历史视图建索引，按目标视角可见面元取回少量最相关视图作上下文，低成本保持交互式场景探索的一致性。
tldr_en: Indexes past views by the 3D surfels they observed and retrieves only the most relevant ones for each new view, keeping interactive scene exploration consistent at a fraction of full-context cost.

title: Plenoptic Video Generation
tldr_zh: 针对多视角生成式重渲染中幻觉区域不一致，自回归训练多入单出模型，按相机引导检索先前生成的视频作条件以同步各视角。
tldr_en: Keeps hallucinated content synchronized across views in camera-controlled video re-rendering by training a multi-in-single-out model autoregressively and retrieving earlier generated videos, chosen by camera guidance, as conditions.

title: MemCam: Memory-Augmented Camera Control for Consistent Video Generation
tldr_zh: 把已生成帧作外部记忆，压缩成紧凑表示并按共视关系选取相关帧作条件，改善大角度相机旋转下长视频的场景一致性。
tldr_en: Uses previously generated frames as external memory, compresses them into compact features, and selects the most co-visible ones as context, improving scene consistency in long camera-controlled videos with large rotations.

title: Retrieve What's Missing: Coverage-Maximizing Retrieval for Consistent Long Video Generation
tldr_zh: 用预训练 3D 先验估深度构建目标视角覆盖图，按剩余覆盖增益迭代选取历史帧，并用滑窗深度缓存控制开销。
tldr_en: Builds a target-view coverage map from depth predicted by pretrained 3D priors and greedily retrieves past frames covering still-missing regions, with sliding-window depth caching to keep long-video retrieval cheap.

title: Closing the Loop: Training-Free Revisit Consistency for Autoregressive Generative Rendering
tldr_zh: 免训练：按位姿匹配把历史潜变量块取回 KV 缓存作回环记忆，并用深度重投影把注意力偏向几何对应区域，改善回访一致性。
tldr_en: A training-free method that retrieves pose-matched historical latent chunks into the KV cache as loop-closure memory and biases attention toward depth-reprojected corresponding regions, improving revisit consistency in autoregressive generative rendering.

title: EgoLCD: Egocentric Video Generation with Long Context Diffusion
tldr_zh: 把长时第一人称视频生成视为记忆管理，结合长期稀疏KV缓存与LoRA扩展的短期注意力记忆，并加记忆正则损失。
tldr_en: Treats long egocentric video generation as memory management, combining a long-term sparse KV cache with LoRA-adapted short-term attention memory plus a memory regulation loss to reduce content drift.

title: EgoSim: Egocentric World Simulator for Embodied Interaction Generation
tldr_zh: 闭环第一人称世界模拟器，把3D场景当作可更新状态，生成空间一致的交互视频，并在多阶段交互中持续更新场景。
tldr_en: A closed-loop egocentric simulator that treats the 3D scene as an updatable world state, generating spatially consistent interaction videos and updating the scene across multi-stage interactions.

title: DexSIM: Real-time Dexterous Simulation with Unified Causal Video Diffusion
tldr_zh: 实时灵巧手操作模拟：把手部轨迹与视频联合嵌入，再以更新的空间缓存作注意力sink做自回归训练，保持长期一致。
tldr_en: A real-time video simulator for dexterous hand-object interaction that embeds hand trajectories and video in a shared space, then trains autoregressively with an updated spatial cache as an attention sink for long-term consistency.

title: E$^3$C: Video Generation with 3D Environmental Memory and Ego-Exo Human Pose Control
tldr_zh: 第一人称视频生成中，用带外观描述的点云3D记忆渲染到目标视角作条件，并分别控制佩戴者与他人的人体动作。
tldr_en: Generates egocentric video by rendering a point-cloud 3D memory, augmented with appearance descriptors, into target views as conditioning, while separately controlling the camera wearer's and other people's body motion.

title: StreamHOI: Interaction-aware Temporal Memory Adaptation for Streaming HOI Video Generation
tldr_zh: 流式人-物交互视频生成：按各Transformer块的历史偏好设定sink与局部记忆布局并训练，用距离缩放增强远程访问。
tldr_en: A streaming human-object interaction video generator that profiles each transformer block's memory preference, trains block-specific sink-local memory layouts, and scales memory distance to reach early interaction states.

title: EgoGenesis: Egocentric World-Action Modeling with Online Anchored Projective Memory and Action-3D RoPE
tldr_zh: 第一人称操作视频模拟器，用首帧3D锚点加周期刷新的投影记忆保持几何稳定，用相机感知的 3D RoPE 编码末端运动，生成数据扩充机器人训练集。
tldr_en: An egocentric manipulation video simulator that keeps a first-frame 3D anchor plus periodically refreshed projective memory, and encodes end-effector motion with camera-aware 3D RoPE to generate robot training data.

title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
tldr_zh: 多智能体第一人称世界模型，在共享token序列中联合去噪多路视角，以全体位姿与共享环境记忆保持世界一致。
tldr_en: A multi-agent egocentric world model that jointly denoises several ego streams in one token sequence, conditioning each on all agents' poses and a shared environment memory to keep the shared world consistent.

title: MagicWorld: Towards Long-Horizon Stability for Interactive Video World Exploration
tldr_zh: 自回归交互式视频世界模型，用光流约束缓解动态主体运动漂移，用历史缓存检索与多段蒸馏减少长程误差累积。
tldr_en: An autoregressive interactive video world model that curbs dynamic-subject motion drift with flow-guided constraints and reduces long-horizon error accumulation via history-cache retrieval and multi-shot distillation.

title: AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon World Modeling -- Full Technical Report
tldr_zh: 150亿参数交互式长程视频世界模型，上下文组合sink帧、压缩历史、几何对齐空间记忆与近期帧，并用自展开误差训练。
tldr_en: A 15B interactive long-horizon video world model whose bounded context combines a sink frame, compressed history, geometry-aligned spatial memory and recent frames, trained on corrupted self-rollout histories.

title: Wonder: Video World Model Done Better
tldr_zh: 实时相机可控世界探索模型，以稠密坐标场渲染作相机条件，用稀疏注意力记忆只读少量相关上下文token。
tldr_en: A real-time camera-controllable world exploration model that conditions on rendered dense coordinate fields and uses sparse-attention memory to attend only to a few relevant context tokens.

title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
tldr_zh: 交互世界模型训练时让局部与全局注意力头分工，推理时用有界KV缓存加位姿索引地标库检索，兼顾控制、记忆与实时。
tldr_en: An interactive world model that trains mixed local/global attention heads and, at inference, pairs a bounded KV cache with a pose-indexed landmark bank to recall past views under a fixed budget.

title: SPW-Nav: A Streaming Panoramic World Model for Language-Guided Navigation
tldr_zh: 由语言指令驱动的流式全景世界模型，从单张全景实时生成一分钟2K 360°视频，用多项记忆延续场景。
tldr_en: A streaming panoramic world model that turns movement instructions into camera motion and streams one minute of 2K 360° video from a single panorama, using multi-term memory to continue the scene.

title: WorldPlay: Towards Long-Term Geometric Consistency for Real-Time Interactive World Modeling
tldr_zh: 实时流式交互世界模型，用重组上下文记忆保留几何上重要的远期帧，并用对齐记忆上下文的Context Forcing蒸馏。
tldr_en: A real-time streaming interactive world model that rebuilds context to keep geometrically important past frames accessible, and distills with Context Forcing that aligns teacher and student memory context.

title: TeleWorld: Towards Dynamic Multimodal Synthesis with a 4D World Model
tldr_zh: 实时4D世界模型，把生成视频持续重建成动态4D表示，再用它引导后续生成，以保持长时空间与动态一致。
tldr_en: A real-time 4D world model that continuously reconstructs generated video into a dynamic 4D representation which then guides subsequent generation, targeting long-term spatial and dynamic consistency.

title: InSpatio-WorldFM: An Open-Source Real-Time Generative Frame Model
tldr_zh: 逐帧独立生成的实时帧模型，用显式3D锚点与隐式空间记忆保持多视角一致，支持消费级GPU上交互探索。
tldr_en: A real-time frame model that generates each frame independently, using explicit 3D anchors and implicit spatial memory for multi-view consistency, enabling interactive exploration on consumer GPUs.

title: WorldCam: Interactive Autoregressive 3D Gaming Worlds with Camera Pose as a Unifying Geometric Representation
tldr_zh: 以相机位姿统一动作控制与长程3D一致：用户输入转为6自由度位姿注入生成，并以全局位姿为索引检索历史观测。
tldr_en: Uses camera pose as a shared representation for gaming world models: user inputs become 6-DoF poses for action control, and global poses index past observations for consistent revisits.

title: INSPATIO-WORLD: A Real-Time 4D World Simulator via Spatiotemporal Autoregressive Modeling
tldr_zh: 从单段参考视频恢复可交互4D场景的实时模型，用隐式时空缓存聚合历史观测，用显式空间约束保证几何与相机控制。
tldr_en: A real-time model that turns a single reference video into a navigable 4D scene, aggregating past observations in an implicit spatiotemporal cache and enforcing geometry with explicit spatial constraints.

title: Matrix-Game 3.0: Real-Time and Streaming Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
tldr_zh: 720p实时交互世界模型，用相机感知记忆检索与注入保持长程一致，并训练模型对回注的含误差生成帧自我纠正；5B 模型最高 40 FPS。
tldr_en: A 720p real-time interactive world model using camera-aware memory retrieval and injection for long-horizon consistency, trained to self-correct on re-injected imperfect frames; the 5B model reaches up to 40 FPS.

title: SANA-WM: Efficient Minute-Scale World Modeling with Hybrid Linear Diffusion Transformer
tldr_zh: 26亿参数分钟级世界模型，混合帧级Gated DeltaNet与softmax注意力建模长上下文，并配双分支相机控制。
tldr_en: A 2.6B-parameter minute-scale world model that mixes frame-wise Gated DeltaNet with softmax attention for memory-efficient long context, plus dual-branch 6-DoF camera control.

title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
tldr_zh: 通用交互式视频世界模型，按相机几何检索早期视图保持重访一致，用自生成长上下文训练减少自回归漂移，并支持用提示触发事件。
tldr_en: A general interactive video world model that retrieves earlier views by camera geometry for revisit consistency and trains on self-generated long contexts to reduce autoregressive drift; supports promptable events.

title: WorldCraft: From Camera Navigation to Object Manipulation in Interactive Video World Models
tldr_zh: 在可导航视频世界模型中加入物体轨迹控制；物体在视野外被移动后，重入时屏蔽离开前的旧记忆帧以保持新状态。
tldr_en: Adds object-trajectory control to a camera-navigable autoregressive video world model, anchoring paths in world coordinates and masking stale pre-exit memory frames so action-updated object states persist through off-screen intervals.

title: ActWorld: From Explorable to Interactive World Model via Action-Aware Memory
tldr_zh: 让交互世界模型支持物体交互：按交互重要性路由历史压缩，并用持久记忆库保存事件更新与物体身份token。
tldr_en: Extends navigation-centric interactive world models to object interaction, routing history compression by interaction importance and keeping event-update and object-identity tokens in a persistent memory bank.

title: WorldDirector: Building Controllable World Simulators with Persistent Dynamic Memory
tldr_zh: 用LLM编排3D物体轨迹与相机运动作为生成控制信号，把运动与渲染解耦，使动态物体长时间离开视野后重入仍保持一致。
tldr_en: Decouples motion from rendering: an LLM orchestrates 3D object trajectories and camera moves as control signals, so dynamic objects keep identity and plausible motion when re-entering after long off-screen periods.

title: World Observer: Joint Actor-Observer Generation for Persistent World Modeling
tldr_zh: 联合生成主体视角与全景观察者视频，使离开视野的物体在观察流中继续演化、重入时状态正确，并提出视野外评测。
tldr_en: Jointly generates the actor view and panoramic observer streams so objects leaving the actor's view keep evolving in the observer and re-enter with updated states; adds an out-of-view benchmark.

title: Ctrl-World: A Controllable Generative World Model for Robot Manipulation
tldr_zh: 面向通用操作策略评估与改进的多视角可控世界模型，用位姿条件记忆检索保持长程一致，并用想象成功轨迹微调策略。
tldr_en: A multi-view, action-controllable world model for evaluating and improving generalist manipulation policies, using pose-conditioned memory retrieval for long-horizon consistency and imagined successes for policy fine-tuning.

title: WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation
tldr_zh: 多视角机器人操作世界模型，用flow matching预测未来潜变量与奖励，兼顾保真、长程一致与效率，用于策略评估、策略改进与测试时规划。
tldr_en: A multi-view manipulation world model trained with flow matching to predict future latents and rewards, designed for fidelity, long-horizon consistency, and speed in policy evaluation, policy improvement, and test-time planning.

title: Mem-World: Memory-Augmented Action-Conditioned World Models for Persistent Robot Manipulation
tldr_zh: 操作世界模型中构建以腕部视角为中心的4D面元记忆，按未来动作推出相机位姿渲染打分来检索历史帧；用于策略评估时，与真机表现的相关性比 Ctrl-World 高。
tldr_en: Builds a wrist-view-centered 4D surfel memory for manipulation world models, retrieving history frames by rendering surfels at action-predicted future camera poses; improves policy-evaluation correlation over Ctrl-World.

title: Remembering What Matters for Long-Horizon Robotic World Models
tldr_zh: 免训练的机器人视频世界模型上下文调度：只保留初始场景锚点与最近若干视觉-动作块，丢弃陈旧的生成历史。
tldr_en: A training-free context schedule for frozen autoregressive robot video world models that keeps the initial scene anchor and recent visual-action blocks while evicting stale generated history.

title: World Model for Robot Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
tldr_zh: 从机器人学习视角综述世界模型：与策略的耦合、作为强化学习与评测的模拟器、机器人视频世界模型的演进，并延伸到导航和驾驶。
tldr_en: Surveys world models for robot learning, covering how they couple with policies, serve as learned simulators for RL and evaluation, and have evolved as robotic video models, with extensions to navigation and driving.

title: World Action Models: The Next Frontier in Embodied AI
tldr_zh: 把联合预测未来状态与动作的模型定义为世界动作模型，按级联/联合架构分类，并梳理数据来源与评测协议。
tldr_en: Defines World Action Models as embodied models that predict future states jointly with actions, organizes them into cascaded and joint designs, and surveys their data sources and evaluation protocols.

title: Do World Models Make Better Robots? A Survey of Evaluation Benchmarks for Predictive Embodied Intelligence
tldr_zh: 梳理 160 个具身评测基准并按评测方式、能力和模型族分四类，指出很少有基准直接对比世界模型与 VLA 策略，并提出评测方案。
tldr_en: Catalogs 160 embodied benchmarks into four lanes by evaluation mode, capability, and model family, finds few that contrast world models with VLA policies, and proposes advantage-aware metrics.

title: World-Action Models for Robot Learning and Control: A Survey
tldr_zh: 从机器人角度综述世界动作模型，按表示、转移建模、动作接口、架构和训练分类，覆盖操作、导航、驾驶、评测与开放问题。
tldr_en: A robotics-oriented review of World-Action Models, organizing methods by representation, transition modeling, action interface, architecture, and training, and covering manipulation, navigation, driving, evaluation, and open challenges.

title: The Past Frames the Future: Memory for Autoregressive Video Generation
tldr_zh: 把自回归视频生成中的记忆定义为跨步保留并影响后续生成的历史信息，从形式、功能、操作、学习、评测五个角度系统梳理。
tldr_en: Defines memory in autoregressive video generation as history that persists across rollout steps, and organizes the literature by forms, functions, operations, learning, and evaluation, ending with open challenges.

title: StreamingT2V: Consistent, Dynamic, and Extendable Long Video Generation from Text
tldr_zh: 文生长视频的自回归方法：短期记忆模块用注意力读取上一片段的特征以衔接片段，长期记忆模块从首个片段提取场景与物体特征，防止遗忘初始场景。
tldr_en: An autoregressive text-to-long-video method whose short-term memory attends to features of the previous chunk for smooth transitions, while a long-term memory extracts scene and object features from the first chunk so the initial scene is not forgotten.

title: Long-Context Autoregressive Video Modeling with Next-Frame Prediction
tldr_zh: 建立逐帧自回归视频建模基线FAR，并利用远帧主要充当上下文记忆的冗余，对远帧用大核非对称分块压缩token、近帧保留细节，降低长视频训练开销。
tldr_en: Builds FAR, a frame-level autoregressive video baseline, and exploits the redundancy of distant frames, which mainly serve as context memory, by patchifying them with larger kernels while keeping standard kernels for nearby frames, cutting the cost of long-video training.

title: One-Minute Video Generation with Test-Time Training
tldr_zh: 在预训练Transformer中加入测试时训练（TTT）层，其隐藏状态本身是神经网络，用更具表达力的状态承载长上下文，按文本分镜生成一分钟视频。
tldr_en: Adds test-time training layers, whose hidden states are themselves neural networks, to a pretrained Transformer so that a more expressive state carries the long context, generating one-minute videos from text storyboards.

title: Frame Context Packing and Drift Prevention in Next-Frame-Prediction Video Diffusion Models
tldr_zh: 为逐帧预测视频扩散模型按帧重要性压缩历史上下文，越重要的帧保留越长的上下文，并用提前确定端点、调整采样顺序和离散历史表示抑制漂移。
tldr_en: Packs past frames into a fixed context length for next-frame-prediction video diffusion, giving more important frames longer contexts, and counters drift with early-fixed endpoints, adjusted sampling orders, and discrete history representations.

title: WorldExplorer: Towards Generating Fully Navigable 3D Scenes
tldr_zh: 从360度全景出发沿预设短轨迹迭代生成视频以扩展场景，用场景记忆为每段视频检索最相关的历史视角作条件，最后融合为三维高斯场景。
tldr_en: Expands a scene from a 360-degree panorama by iteratively generating videos along short trajectories, conditioning each on the most relevant prior views retrieved from a scene memory, then fuses all views into 3D Gaussians.

title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
tldr_zh: 在大规模互联网视频上自监督预训练联合嵌入预测模型，再用少量机器人视频后训练成动作条件隐空间世界模型，以图像目标规划完成抓放。
tldr_en: Pretrains a joint-embedding predictive model on internet-scale video without labels, then post-trains it on a small amount of robot video into an action-conditioned latent world model that plans pick-and-place toward image goals.

title: Hunyuan-GameCraft: High-dynamic Interactive Game Video Generation with Hybrid History Condition
tldr_zh: 面向游戏的交互式视频生成，把键鼠输入统一到相机表示空间，用混合历史条件训练自回归地延长视频并保留场景信息，再蒸馏以支持实时生成。
tldr_en: An interactive game video generator that maps keyboard and mouse inputs into a shared camera space, extends videos autoregressively with hybrid history-conditioned training to retain scene information, and is distilled for real-time play.

title: Yume: An Interactive World Generation Model
tldr_zh: 交互式视频世界生成系统，从图像出发用键盘控制探索，以带记忆模块的掩码视频扩散Transformer自回归生成无限长视频，并配合相机运动量化、免训练采样改进与模型加速。
tldr_en: An interactive world generation system that turns an image into a keyboard-explorable world, using a masked video diffusion transformer with a memory module for unbounded autoregressive generation, plus quantized camera motion, training-free sampler improvements, and model acceleration.

title: Mixture of Contexts for Long Video Generation
tldr_zh: 把长视频生成视为长上下文记忆检索问题，用可学习的稀疏注意力路由让每个查询只关注少量相关历史片段和必选锚点，并以因果路由避免回环。
tldr_en: Treats long video generation as long-context memory retrieval, with a learnable sparse attention router that lets each query attend only to a few relevant history chunks plus mandatory anchors, and causal routing that prevents loop closures.

title: LongLive: Real-time Interactive Long Video Generation
tldr_zh: 帧级自回归长视频生成框架，用短窗口注意力配合帧级注意力汇点保留长程一致性，以KV重缓存应对提示切换，并通过流式长序列微调对齐训练与推理。
tldr_en: A frame-level autoregressive framework for interactive long video generation that pairs short-window attention with a frame-level attention sink to keep long-range consistency, refreshes the KV cache on prompt switches, and aligns training with inference through streaming long tuning.

title: Rolling Forcing: Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion in Real Time
tldr_zh: 流式长视频生成中，以噪声递增的多帧联合去噪抑制误差传播，并用注意力汇点保留初始帧的 KV 作为全局锚点，以保持长程一致性。
tldr_en: For streaming long video generation, jointly denoises several frames at increasing noise levels to curb error propagation, and keeps the key–value states of the initial frames as an attention sink that anchors long-range consistency.

title: Pack and Force Your Memory: Long-form and Consistent Video Generation
tldr_zh: 长视频生成中提出 MemoryPack，以文本和图像为全局引导、可学习地检索上下文，同时建模短期与长期依赖；另用单步近似的 Direct Forcing 缩小训练与推理差异。
tldr_en: Proposes MemoryPack, a learnable context-retrieval mechanism guided by text and images that models short- and long-term dependencies in long video generation, plus Direct Forcing, a single-step approximation that narrows the train–inference gap.

title: 3D Scene Prompting for Scene-Consistent Camera-Controllable Video Generation
tldr_zh: 同时以时间相邻帧和空间相邻内容为条件，并用带动态掩码的SLAM从整段输入视频提取仅含静态几何的三维场景记忆，投影到目标视角作空间提示。
tldr_en: Conditions on both temporally adjacent frames and spatially adjacent content, building a static-only 3D scene memory from the whole input video with dynamically masked SLAM and projecting it to the target view as a spatial prompt.

title: Captain Safari: A World Engine
tldr_zh: 位姿条件的世界引擎，沿相机路径维护动态局部记忆，用检索器取出与位姿对齐的世界token作条件，在激进六自由度轨迹下保持三维结构稳定。
tldr_en: A pose-conditioned world engine that maintains a dynamic local memory along the camera path and uses a retriever to fetch pose-aligned world tokens as conditioning, keeping 3D structure stable under aggressive 6-DoF trajectories.

title: VideoSSM: Autoregressive Long Video Generation with Hybrid State-Space Memory
tldr_zh: 将自回归扩散与混合状态空间记忆结合：状态空间模型作为随序列演化的全局场景记忆，局部上下文窗口保留运动与细节，以线性开销维持分钟级视频的一致性。
tldr_en: Pairs autoregressive diffusion with a hybrid state-space memory, where an SSM carries an evolving global memory of the scene and a local context window keeps motion cues and fine detail, keeping minute-long videos coherent at linear cost.

title: Deep Forcing: Training-Free Long Video Generation with Deep Sink and Participative Compression
tldr_zh: 针对自回归视频扩散的免训练KV cache管理：Deep Sink把一半滑动窗口留给持久的sink token并重新对齐其时间RoPE，参与式压缩只保留参与近期注意力的token，丢弃冗余与退化的历史。
tldr_en: Training-free KV cache management for autoregressive video diffusion: Deep Sink reserves half the sliding window for persistent sink tokens with re-aligned temporal RoPE, and Participative Compression keeps only tokens active in recent attention, dropping redundant or degraded history.

title: MemFlow: Flowing Adaptive Memory for Consistent and Efficient Long Video Narratives
tldr_zh: 流式视频生成中，每生成一段前按该段文本提示检索最相关的历史帧来更新记忆库，生成时每个查询只激活记忆库中最相关的token，兼顾长上下文一致性与效率。
tldr_en: For streaming video generation, refreshes the memory bank before each chunk by retrieving the historical frames most relevant to that chunk's text prompt, and lets each attention query use only the most relevant memory tokens, keeping long-context consistency at low cost.

title: Memorize-and-Generate: Towards Long-Term Consistency in Real-Time Video Generation
tldr_zh: 把记忆压缩与帧生成拆成两个任务：训练记忆模型将历史压缩为紧凑KV cache，由独立生成器据此生成后续帧，并构建MAG-Bench检验历史记忆保持。
tldr_en: Splits memory compression from frame generation, training a memory model to compress history into a compact KV cache that a separate generator conditions on, and introduces MAG-Bench to test how well history is retained.

title: Advancing Open-source World Models
tldr_zh: 从视频生成出发的开源交互式世界模拟器，在多种风格环境中保持动态真实，支持分钟级生成并维持上下文一致，即长期记忆，同时实现实时交互。
tldr_en: An open-source interactive world simulator built from video generation that covers diverse visual styles, sustains minute-long rollouts with consistent context, which the authors call long-term memory, and responds in real time.

title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control
tldr_zh: 自回归扩散框架，在共享隐空间中同时学习帧预测与策略执行，以闭环展开引入真实观测反馈，并异步并行动作预测与执行。
tldr_en: An autoregressive diffusion framework that learns frame prediction and policy execution in a shared latent space, feeds back real observations through closed-loop rollout, and runs action prediction and execution asynchronously.

title: Context Forcing: Consistent Autoregressive Video Generation with Long Context
tldr_zh: 指出用只看短窗口的教师蒸馏长上下文学生会造成监督错配，改用能看到完整生成历史的长上下文教师训练学生，并以Slow-Fast记忆管理线性增长的上下文。
tldr_en: Argues that distilling a long-context student from a short-window teacher leaves global dependencies unsupervised, and instead trains the student with a long-context teacher that sees the full generation history, using a Slow-Fast Memory to keep the growing context tractable.

title: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies
tldr_zh: 基于预训练视频扩散骨干的世界动作模型，联合预测未来视频与动作，从异构机器人数据中学习技能并实现实时闭环控制。
tldr_en: A world action model built on a pretrained video diffusion backbone that jointly predicts future video and actions, learning skills from heterogeneous robot data and running real-time closed-loop control.

title: Geometry-as-context: Modulating Explicit 3D in Scene-consistent Video Generation to Geometry Context
tldr_zh: 让自回归相机控制视频模型交替估计当前视角几何以重建三维场景、再修复由该场景渲染的新视角图像，加入相机门控注意力，并在训练中随机丢弃几何上下文，使推理时可只输出RGB。
tldr_en: Has a single autoregressive camera-controlled video model alternate between estimating the geometry of the current view for 3D reconstruction and restoring novel views rendered from that scene, adding camera-gated attention and randomly dropping the geometry context during training so the model can output RGB alone at inference.

title: MultiGen: Level-Design for Editable Multiplayer Worlds in Diffusion Game Engines
tldr_zh: 为扩散游戏引擎引入独立于上下文窗口的显式外部记忆，由用户动作持续更新并在生成中查询，将生成拆为记忆、观测和动力学模块，支持可编辑关卡与多人共享世界。
tldr_en: Gives a diffusion game engine an explicit external memory that lives outside the context window, is updated by player actions and queried throughout the rollout, and splits generation into memory, observation and dynamics modules to support editable levels and shared multiplayer worlds.

title: MemRoPE: Training-Free Infinite Video Generation via Evolving Memory Tokens
tldr_zh: 免训练的无限视频生成框架，用指数滑动平均把全部历史键压缩进长短期两路固定大小的记忆token，并缓存未旋转的键、在注意力计算时再施加位置编码，避免聚合时的位置相位冲突。
tldr_en: A training-free framework for unbounded video generation that compresses all past keys into fixed-size long- and short-term memory tokens via exponential moving averages, and caches unrotated keys so positional embeddings are applied at attention time, avoiding phase conflicts during aggregation.

title: CausalCine: Real-Time Autoregressive Generation for Multi-Shot Video Narratives
tldr_zh: 把多镜头视频生成变为在线导演式的因果自回归生成，支持镜头切换和随时输入的提示，并提出内容感知记忆路由，按注意力相关度而非时间远近检索历史KV，在有限活跃记忆下保持跨镜头连贯。
tldr_en: Recasts multi-shot video generation as online, causal directing that handles shot changes and prompts given on the fly, with Content-Aware Memory Routing that retrieves past KV entries by attention relevance rather than recency to keep shots coherent under a bounded active memory.

title: Head Forcing: Long Autoregressive Video Generation via Head Heterogeneity
tldr_zh: 发现自回归视频扩散模型的注意力头分为局部、锚点和记忆三类，为每类分配不同的 KV cache 策略，记忆头使用带情景更新的分层记忆，无需训练即可延长生成。
tldr_en: Finds that attention heads in autoregressive video diffusion play local, anchor, and memory roles, and gives each type its own KV-cache policy, with memory heads using a hierarchical memory updated episodically, extending generation without training.

title: Remember to be Curious: Episodic Context and Persistent Worlds for 3D Exploration
tldr_zh: 指出好奇心驱动的智能体陷入回环源于缺乏空间持久性和情景上下文，用持续更新的在线3D重建作为持久世界模型计算好奇心奖励，并以基于RGB序列模型的策略保留轨迹历史。
tldr_en: Traces the loops that trap curiosity-driven agents to a lack of spatial persistence and episodic context, using a continually updated online 3D reconstruction as a persistent world model for curiosity rewards and a sequence-model policy over RGB frames to keep the trajectory history.

title: Light Interaction: Training-Free Inference Acceleration for Interactive Video World Models
tldr_zh: 免训练的交互式视频世界模型加速框架，按相机轨迹自适应管理上下文，探索新区域时丢弃检索的空间记忆、回访时复用早期去噪输出，并结合三维块稀疏注意力。
tldr_en: A training-free acceleration framework for interactive video world models that manages context along the camera trajectory, dropping retrieved spatial memory during novel exploration and reusing early denoising outputs on revisits, combined with 3D block-sparse attention.

title: LongLive-RAG: A General Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Long Video Generation
tldr_zh: 把自回归长视频生成表述为检索增强生成，每生成一块就用查询嵌入从已生成的latent中检索相关历史作条件，并用窗口时间差损失让嵌入关注有意义的时间变化。
tldr_en: Frames autoregressive long video generation as retrieval-augmented generation: at each block a query embedding retrieves relevant past latents as context, and a window temporal delta loss steers the embeddings toward meaningful temporal change instead of local similarity.

title: MilliVid: Hierarchical Latents for Long-Range Consistency in Video Generation
tldr_zh: 把每帧编码为从完整潜变量到少量token的层级表示，按由粗到细展开生成，并控制历史帧以何种细节层级作上下文，以保持长程几何与物体持续性。
tldr_en: Encodes each frame into a token hierarchy from full latent resolution down to a handful of tokens and generates coarse to fine, controlling the level of detail at which past frames serve as context to keep long-range geometry and object permanence.

title: PermaVid: Consistent Video Generation Across Edits via Disentangled Context Memory
tldr_zh: 针对编辑后存储的上下文过时或失效，把空间上下文拆成RGB外观记忆和仅含几何的深度记忆，用编辑感知的记忆更新与检索让记忆随后续观测演化。
tldr_en: Targets memory that goes stale after scene edits, splitting spatial context into an RGB appearance bank and a geometry-only depth bank, with edit-aware update and retrieval that keep memory in step with later observations.

title: Walking in the Implicit: Interactive World Exploration via Neural Scene Representation
tldr_zh: 把交互生成的展开变量从帧latent换成定长、可渲染的隐式场景状态NIS，由扩散Transformer根据未来相机轨迹和几何感知检索的历史演化该状态，再按位姿确定性渲染。
tldr_en: Replaces frame latents with a fixed-length, renderable neural implicit scene state as the rollout variable; a diffusion transformer evolves this state from future camera paths and geometry-aware retrieved history, and views are rendered deterministically from pose.

title: Surprise Forcing: What to Remember, When to Skip in Long Video Generation
tldr_zh: 免训练的流式自回归视频生成框架，把被淘汰的帧概括为value token描述子，按新颖度信号和反馈控制的预算决定准入与替换，并按块难度跳过部分去噪步。
tldr_en: A training-free framework for streaming autoregressive video generation that summarizes evicted frames as value-token descriptors, admits and replaces them in a memory bank by novelty under a feedback-controlled budget, and skips denoising steps for easy chunks.

title: ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU
tldr_zh: 可在单卡桌面GPU实时运行的动作条件视频世界模型，用LongForcing将学生的长自展开对齐到长时域教师以减少漂移，并以参考角色记忆保持第三人称身份一致。
tldr_en: A real-time action-conditioned video world model that runs on a single desktop GPU, aligning long student self-rollouts with an extended-horizon teacher via LongForcing and keeping third-person identity consistent with a reference-character memory.

title: Persistent Computational State: A Session-Centric Runtime for Generative World Models
tldr_zh: 指出世界模型回访失败部分源于请求式服务丢弃了运行时状态，定义必须跨请求保留的最小不可重算状态，并据此构建支持快照与恢复的会话式运行时。
tldr_en: Argues that revisit failures partly come from request-centric serving that throws away runtime state, defines the minimal non-recomputable state that must persist across requests, and builds a session-centric runtime that checkpoints and restores it.

title: Streaming Multi-Agent Autoregressive Diffusion Model with World State Registers
tldr_zh: 在多智能体流式视频扩散中加入跨智能体世界状态寄存器，用可学习token存储共享世界信息和各智能体状态，每段生成后更新，并以智能体状态、鸟瞰图和场景文本监督。
tldr_en: Adds cross-agent world-state registers to a streaming multi-agent video diffusion model: learnable tokens that hold shared world information and each agent's status, updated after every chunk and supervised with agent status, bird's-eye views and scene text.

title: StatePlay: State-Aware Game World Models for Mechanics-Consistent Generation
tldr_zh: 游戏世界模型在生成画面的同时联合预测生命值、技能条、计时器等内部状态，用混合Transformer架构分设视觉与状态分支并相互交互，由预测状态引导帧生成，使生成符合游戏机制。
tldr_en: A game world model that predicts internal states such as health, skill meters, and timers alongside frames, using a mixture-of-transformers with separate but interacting visual and state branches so the predicted state steers generation toward rule-consistent gameplay.

title: WorldCycle: Self-Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Video World Models
tldr_zh: 利用动作序列接其逆序列必回到初始状态这一性质，为交互式视频世界模型构造免标注的强化学习奖励，约束正反段对称与多次循环间的状态一致，并发布检验回到原状态能力的诊断基准CycleBench。
tldr_en: Exploits the fact that an action sequence followed by its inverse must return to the starting state, turning closed action cycles into annotation-free RL rewards for spatial closure and cross-cycle consistency, and releases CycleBench to diagnose whether world models can return to earlier states.

title: HarnessWAM: Bridging Prediction and Deliberation in World Action Models
tldr_zh: 为世界动作模型加上智能体式编排，由VLM任务管理器维护基于证据的场景信念和任务图，结合进度估计与事件触发的审议来验证执行、修订计划，并在失败恢复时保留已获取的场景知识。
tldr_en: Wraps a world action model in an agentic harness: a VLM task manager keeps an evidence-grounded scene belief and a task graph, while a progress estimator and event-triggered deliberation verify execution, revise plans, and preserve acquired scene knowledge during recovery.

title: PlayWorld: Benchmarking World Models with Agent Players over Long-Horizon Objectives
tldr_zh: 用多模态智能体玩家为不同世界模型自行规划动作以完成长程目标，从几何一致性、交互保真、视野外演化与视野内演化等维度比较交互式视频世界模型。
tldr_en: Uses multimodal agent players to pursue long-horizon objectives in each world model with their own action sequences, comparing interactive video world models on geometric consistency, interaction fidelity, and state evolution both in and out of view.

title: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World
tldr_zh: 把场景几何存入外部按相机索引的世界状态库、只检索与当前视角相关的部分，并设计稀疏注意力教师提供长程监督，在自展开下用分布匹配蒸馏给少步学生。
tldr_en: Keeps scene geometry in an external camera-indexed world-state bank that is queried per view, and builds a sparse-attention teacher for long-horizon supervision, distilled into a few-step student by distribution matching under self-forced rollouts.

title: Code World Model: Coding Agent as World Brain
tldr_zh: 把世界演化与画面生成分离：编码智能体推理事件后果并生成可执行代码维护持久世界状态，再编译为逐帧时空约束的代理视频，条件化视频模型渲染画面。
tldr_en: Separates world evolution from rendering: a coding agent reasons about events and writes executable code that keeps a persistent world state, which is compiled into a proxy video of spatiotemporal constraints for a video model to render.

title: Ring Forcing: Towards Precise Long-Term Memory for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
tldr_zh: 针对自回归视频扩散的长期记忆，用环形训练强制模型从远历史检索以保证物体再现，并以压缩和时间步组合扩展历史跨度、以稀疏RoPE灵活适配记忆。
tldr_en: Builds long-term memory into autoregressive video diffusion with a ring-structured training scheme that forces retrieval from distant history, plus compression and timestep composition to extend the history span and a sparse RoPE for flexible memory adaptation.

title: RECAP-Forcing: Retaining Content Appearances for Long Video Generation
tldr_zh: 按外观新颖性而非时间远近组织记忆：在新主体、去遮挡区域或新场景首次出现时保留其KV缓存，开头用注意力汇点保存初始场景，之后由基于光流的新颖性库选择性保留新内容，无需训练。
tldr_en: Organizes memory by appearance novelty instead of recency, keeping the KV cache of newly appearing subjects, disoccluded regions, and new scenes when they first become visible; an attention sink holds the opening scene and an optical-flow novelty bank retains later content, all without training.

title: LayerRecall: A State-Conditioned Memory Router for Long-Horizon Consistency in Video Generation
tldr_zh: 按当前状态从历史中检索相关K/V，只注入主干中对记忆敏感的层，其余层保持局部注意力，并用长上下文参考在预测空间监督有界记忆下的路由器。
tldr_en: A state-conditioned router that retrieves relevant historical K/V states and injects them only into memory-sensitive backbone layers, keeping local attention elsewhere, and is supervised in prediction space by a privileged long-context reference.

title: Can Video World Models Track Unobserved World States?
tldr_zh: 用动作条件的视频猜杯子游戏检验世界模型能否跟踪未观测状态，分析因果Transformer只追加的KV cache为何无法泛化到更长的交换序列，指出需要可修改的跨块状态，并比较线性注意力与非线性TTT快权重。
tldr_en: Uses an action-conditioned video shell game to test whether world models track hidden state, explains why the append-only KV cache of causal Transformers fails on longer swap chains, and shows that length generalization needs a revisable state carried across chunks, which suitable linear attention or nonlinear TTT fast weights can provide.

title: Motus2: A Self-Evolving General World Model for Dexterous Manipulation
tldr_zh: 灵巧操作的自进化通用世界模型，以同一套权重提供策略、模拟器和评估器三种接口形成决策与学习闭环，并研究了对滑动窗口上下文的全局自回归与混合记忆扩展。
tldr_en: A self-evolving world model for dexterous manipulation whose shared weights serve as policy, simulator and value model in a closed decision-and-learning loop, and which explores global-autoregressive and hybrid-memory extensions of its sliding-window context.

title: OctWorld: Long-Range World-Consistent Video Generation with Octree-Based 3D Mapping
tldr_zh: 用动态稀疏八叉树上的TSDF融合，把生成的画面与深度逐步并入分辨率随图像证据自适应的全局3D记忆OctMap，使长距离相机轨迹下的回访保持一致。
tldr_en: Progressively fuses generated frames and their depth into OctMap, a global 3D memory built by TSDF fusion in a dynamic sparse octree whose resolution adapts to image evidence, keeping long-range camera-controlled generation consistent on revisits.

title: Do Video Generators Track the World Across Segments? A Benchmark and Method for World-State Reasoning in Video Continuation
tldr_zh: 提出Statebench，检验视频续写能否反映由历史视频和新提示共同决定的世界状态，涵盖过去可见、被遮挡过程和复杂转变三类状态；并提出显式维护、更新实体状态再以预测终帧引导生成的Stateagent。
tldr_en: Introduces Statebench, which tests whether a video continuation reflects the world state implied by both the earlier video and a new prompt across past-visible, occluded-process, and complex-transition states, and proposes Stateagent, which maintains and updates an explicit entity-state representation and renders the next segment from a predicted end frame.

title: TourPhysics: Bringing Physics to World Models for Exploration and Manipulation from a Single Image
tldr_zh: 从单张图像和声明式物理配置出发，将确定性物理仿真与视频生成结合，分离模拟器状态、几何证据、生成控制和外观记忆的职责，并以参考锚定记忆按几何对应检索已接受的静态外观，减轻回访时的外观漂移。
tldr_en: Starts from a single image and a declarative physics setup, couples deterministic simulation with video generation by giving simulator state, geometric evidence, generator controls, and appearance memory separate roles, and uses a reference-anchored memory that retrieves accepted static appearance through cross-view correspondence to curb drift on revisits.

title: Does Video Memory Use What It Retrieves? A Causal Audit of Memory Specificity
tldr_zh: 提出读取时记忆替换，把模型读取的记忆值换成无关或错误内容而其余计算不变，以区分记忆带来的收益是否真正依赖检索到的内容，并用它审计多个冻结的视频世界模型与WorldMem。
tldr_en: Proposes read-time memory substitution, which swaps the memory value a model consumes for unrelated or wrong content while leaving the rest of the computation unchanged, to tell whether memory gains actually depend on the retrieved content, and applies it to audit several frozen video world models including WorldMem.

title: Can 4D Foundation Models Remember?
tldr_zh: 以360度视频作为全知真值，从物体持久性、运动连续性和外观保持三方面评测相机控制视频模型和四维重建模型对离开视野物体的记忆。
tldr_en: Uses 360-degree videos as omniscient ground truth to evaluate how well camera-controllable video models and 4D reconstruction models remember objects after they leave the view, covering object permanence, motion continuity, and appearance preservation.

title: ConsistWorld: Evidence Routing for Consistent Multi-Agent World Models
tldr_zh: 多智能体自回归视频世界模型，把一致性视为证据路由：按位姿从所有智能体的历史观测中检索相关帧，并按历史覆盖和当前视野重叠门控同伴视角信息。
tldr_en: A multi-agent autoregressive video world model that treats consistency as evidence routing, retrieving relevant past observations from all agents by camera pose and gating concurrent peer views by historical coverage and view overlap.

title: Code Plans, Diffusion Renders: Open-Ended Generative World Modeling
tldr_zh: 用代码显式构建可执行的世界规则与动态，再由视频生成模型渲染观测，使世界状态在视野外持续演化并支持长期记忆与多智能体交互。
tldr_en: Builds an executable world in code and uses a video generator only to render it, so the world state persists and evolves outside the current view, supporting long-term memory and multi-agent interaction.

title: QuantWM: Temporally Consistent 2-Bit KV Cache Quantization for Video World Models
tldr_zh: 针对视频世界模型中不断增长的KV cache做免训练2比特量化，通过保持注意力logit和时空token选择，避免量化Key导致的闪烁与画质退化。
tldr_en: A training-free 2-bit KV cache quantization scheme for video world models that preserves attention logits and the spatiotemporal tokens each query selects, avoiding the flicker and degradation caused by quantized keys.

title: Geometry as Address: Routing Attention to Visual Memory for Long-Horizon Camera-Controlled Video Generation
tldr_zh: 将历史观测保留为帧latent而不融合成全局三维表示，仅用逐帧几何建立与目标视角的token级对应作为读取地址，通过几何对应注意力注入匹配的历史特征，并用不可见八叉树剔除被遮挡的对应。
tldr_en: Keeps past observations as frame latents rather than fusing them into a global 3D model, uses per-frame geometry only as token-level addresses into that memory, injects matched historical features through geometric correspondence attention, and rejects occluded matches with an invisible octree.

title: WorldPlay2: Extending Real-Time Interactive World Models in Control and Horizon
tldr_zh: 实时交互世界模型，用分解式混合控制接口，把历史上下文压缩成自回归学生与双向教师共享的记忆token以逐片段蒸馏，并以Stable Forcing和整段回放稳定长程生成。
tldr_en: A real-time interactive world model with a factorized hybrid control interface that compresses history into memory tokens shared by the autoregressive student and bidirectional teacher for clip-wise distillation, stabilized by Stable Forcing with full-rollout replay.

title: WorldWeave: Growing Persistent Geometric Worlds for Video Generation
tldr_zh: 把世界状态维护与视觉渲染解耦，通过持续外扩生成高程图并由智能体组织拼接场景，构建可扩展的显式3D结构记忆，视频生成只读取其几何而不回写。
tldr_en: Decouples world-state upkeep from rendering by growing an explicit 3D world from continually outpainted elevation maps and agent-organized scenes; video generation reads depth from this structural memory through a read-only interface and never writes back.

title: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models
tldr_zh: 提出固定大小的HexMemory，用六个空间与时空平面存储场景特征；写入器把每段新生成内容编码为平面特征，随覆盖范围扩展对旧平面变形并按置信度融合，读取器从中取latent作为后续生成的条件。
tldr_en: Stores scene features in HexMemory, a fixed-size low-rank memory of six spatial and spatiotemporal planes: a feed-forward writer encodes each new chunk, earlier planes are warped and fused by confidence-weighted pooling as coverage grows, and a reader retrieves latents to condition later generation.

title: DeCoPrune: Efficient KV-Cache Pruning for Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Denoising Consistency
tldr_zh: 把KV cache压缩视为去噪一致性问题，以token中间预测与最终去噪结果的差异衡量其信息价值，保留难以从已有上下文预测的token，并构建需回忆早先物体或场景的基准评测信息保留。
tldr_en: Treats KV-cache compression as a denoising-consistency problem, keeping tokens whose intermediate predictions differ most from their final denoised values as the least predictable from retained context, and adds a benchmark of continuation tasks that require recalling earlier objects or scenes.

title: Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window
tldr_zh: 让训练样本覆盖任意长的时间跨度但只对末尾若干块计损失，每块按相机共视检索历史latent组成有界记忆库，从而以有限注意力代价直接监督回访一致性。
tldr_en: Lets a training sample span any length but scores only its last few chunks, each retrieving past latents by camera co-visibility into a bounded shared bank, so revisit consistency can be supervised directly without attending over the whole span.

title: FrameMorrow: Future-guided Frame Selection with Prospective Tokens for Long-Horizon Video Generation
tldr_zh: 预测少量代表未来信息需求的前瞻token，用它们从生成历史中挑选相关的显式帧作为条件，可即插即用于多种生成器。
tldr_en: Predicts a few prospective tokens that stand for future information needs and uses them to pick relevant explicit frames from the generation history, so it plugs into many generators, including closed-source ones.

title: MosaiChunk: Compositing Spatio-Temporal Memory for Autoregressive Video Generation
tldr_zh: 冻结视频生成器，只训练轻量路由器在固定活跃记忆预算下从时空历史中挑选KV片段拼成马赛克，以恢复重现内容的细节，并构建回访基准RememBench。
