tldr_en: Keeps the video generator frozen and trains a lightweight router that picks historical KV sections across space and time into a mosaic under a fixed memory budget, and introduces RememBench for long-horizon revisits.

title: PROWBench: Do Video Models Render What the Program Specifies?
tldr_zh: 以程序化构建的场景记录实体状态与带时间戳的事件（含视野外事件），据此检验生成视频是否遵循程序设定，评测实体控制、长程记忆与事件渲染。
tldr_en: Builds programmatic episodes that log entity states and timestamped events, including those outside the camera view, and checks generated videos against them for entity control, long-horizon memory, and faithful rendering of scheduled events.

title: Oneira: From Open-Ended Generation to Open-World Interaction in Video World Models
tldr_zh: 由编码智能体维护可扩展的显式世界状态表，读取状态、规划交互并写回结果，将新发现的物体纳入状态，再按相机轨迹渲染粗略条件视频交给视频生成器补全细节。
tldr_en: Keeps an explicit, extensible world-state table managed by a coding agent that grounds entities, plans interactions, writes outcomes back, and adds newly discovered objects, then renders the state along the camera path as a coarse video for the generator to fill in.

title: HLA-WM: Hybrid Linear Attention for Long-Horizon Video World Models
tldr_zh: 针对Gated DeltaNet线性注意力的长程遗忘，免训练地缓存分块状态转移摘要，按相机几何检索与当前场景相关的历史分块，并重组为针对查询的循环状态。
tldr_en: A training-free fix for long-range forgetting in Gated DeltaNet world models: it caches compact chunk-wise transition summaries, retrieves scene-relevant chunks by camera geometry, and recomposes them into a query-specific recurrent state.

title: Keepsake: Selective Spatial Memory for Long-Horizon Video Generation
authors: Abdul Mohaimen Al Radi et al.
tldr_zh: 免训练的固定容量空间记忆控制器，在保留帧与新帧上构建位姿-外观图，按可替代视图的数量和最近替代的相似度持续重估每帧的价值，淘汰最容易被替代的观测。
tldr_en: A training-free controller for fixed-capacity spatial memory that builds a pose-appearance graph over stored and newly generated frames, keeps re-scoring each frame by how replaceable it is, and evicts the most redundant views.

title: SearchWorld: Spatial Value-Grounded Imagination for UAV Object Search via World Models
tldr_zh: 面向无人机目标搜索的循环状态空间世界模型，维护BEV探索与障碍记忆并解码任务相关的空间价值层，在想象展开中以该价值先验改进策略。
tldr_en: A recurrent state-space world model for UAV object search that keeps BEV exploration and obstacle memory and decodes a task-aware spatial value layer, which guides policy improvement through imagined rollouts.

title: CORAL-KV: Compact Cross-Layer Prediction and Residual Coding for Autoregressive Video KV Caches
tldr_zh: 利用视频KV cache的跨层依赖，用每层缓存预测下一层的键值并只量化预测残差，以块对角加低秩预测器压缩自回归视频生成的KV cache。
tldr_en: Compresses the KV cache of autoregressive video models by predicting each layer's keys and values from the previous layer with block-diagonal-plus-low-rank predictors and quantizing only the residuals.

title: MultiWorldBench: Do Independently Controlled Views Describe One Shared World?
tldr_zh: 基于Minecraft的多人世界模型诊断基准，涵盖独立控制、共享状态同步、状态持续和延迟回访等能力，以游戏引擎真值为参照，检验各视角是否描述同一个持续的世界。
tldr_en: A Minecraft benchmark for multiplayer world models that tests independent control, shared-state synchronization, persistence and delayed revisits against engine ground truth, checking whether separately controlled views stay consistent with one persistent world.

title: GLIMPSE: Global-Local Indexing with Multi-Precision Spectral Encoding for Explorable Video World Models
tldr_zh: 针对回访时投影误差造成的重影，将局部补丁记忆与循环全局记忆结合，用分频段多精度坐标和几何条件的频谱衰减为历史补丁寻址，并按覆盖足迹在固定读取预算下检索。
tldr_en: Pairs a local patch memory with a recurrent global memory for camera revisits, addressing historical patches with band-wise multi-precision coordinates and geometry-conditioned spectral attenuation so that inaccurate projections cause less ghosting, and retrieves patches by footprint under a fixed read budget.

title: Totem: Object-Centric 3D Memory for World-Consistent Video Generation
tldr_zh: 为选定物体各建一个对齐到共享世界坐标系、带独立状态的持久三维记忆，经双流三维条件与场景几何结合生成目标视角，并用物体记忆约束注意力以保持物体表面和相对布局。
tldr_en: Gives each selected object its own persistent 3D memory and state, aligned to a shared world frame; a dual-stream 3D conditioning branch combines these object memories with scene geometry for target-view synthesis, and they also constrain attention to preserve object surfaces and relative layout.

title: Grid or Nodes? Probing Object Memory in World Models Under Partial Observability
tldr_zh: 在FloWM的方块世界中，将其按内置速度平移的空间特征网格记忆与逐物体记录位置和速度的节点记忆（借助真值的Kalman跟踪器）对照，考察视野外物体的记忆、读出方式和存储开销。
tldr_en: Compares FloWM's spatial feature grid, shifted by built-in velocities, against a node memory that stores each object's position and velocity (an oracle-fed Kalman tracker) in FloWM's own block world, probing out-of-view recall, readout choices and storage cost.

title: Long-horizon Video Generation with Slot Memory Addressed By Region Tokens
tldr_zh: 用固定大小的槽位记忆兼顾有界存储与按空间回忆，写入由观测相机寻址、读取由渲染相机查询，并为每次读取给出置信度，供扩散模型决定在多大程度上信任检索内容。
tldr_en: A constant-size slot memory whose writes are addressed by the observing camera and whose reads are queried by the rendering camera, so recall depends on view geometry rather than recency; each read also returns a confidence that tells the diffusion transformer how far to trust it.

title: Generative World Simulation with DAO and JING
authors: Xgen Team Guohao Cai et al.
tldr_zh: 用可计算的世界引擎按交互规则与世界时间维护人物、物体与空间的状态及关系，并为每个观察者导出条件，交给第一人称交互体验模型结合观测历史生成视听体验。
tldr_en: Couples a computable world engine that advances the states and relations of characters, objects, and spaces under interaction rules and world time with an egocentric model that generates each observer's audiovisual experience from derived conditions and observation history.

title: Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation
tldr_zh: 将剧本编译为带位置、相机和事件时间引用的镜头请求，生成前从注册静态几何的场景记忆和按场景、事件、时间索引的事件记忆中检索证据，生成后经审核与状态检查才将重建结果写回记忆。
tldr_en: Compiles a screenplay into shot requests with explicit location, camera and event-time references, retrieves evidence from a scene memory of registered static geometry and an event memory indexed by scene, event and time, and writes each new clip back only after review and state checks accept it.

title: PAWA: Panoramic Action-conditioned World Modeling for Multiple Agents
tldr_zh: 面向多玩家共享世界的动作条件建模，构建Minecraft中各玩家第一视角视频与世界对齐全景视频配对的数据集，用双塔模型联合预测两路视频，以全景表示视野外的环境变化。
tldr_en: Targets multiplayer world modeling in Minecraft, releasing a dataset that pairs each player's POV video with world-stabilized panoramas and actions, and training a dual-tower model that predicts both streams so changes outside a player's view are captured in the panorama.

title: StateCraft: Augmenting Video World Models with Abstract-State Reasoning
tldr_zh: 将可更新的抽象状态与视觉状态解耦，由语言模型追踪实体随动作的变化，再以该状态条件视频扩散模型生成当前画面，使不可见部分的变化得以保持。
tldr_en: Decouples a persistent, updatable abstract state from the visual state, with a language model tracking how actions change entities and a video diffusion model rendering the current view from that state, so changes to unseen parts of the world are kept.

title: Mallea: Building, Steering, and Memorizing Worlds with Coding Agent
tldr_zh: 由编码智能体根据文本规划物体结构、属性和规则来构建代码世界模型，程序推进显式世界状态，物体纹理记忆保留并随物体变化调整外观，生成式渲染器结合当前结构与记忆的外观生成观测。
tldr_en: A coding agent builds a code world model from text by planning object structure, properties and rules; the program advances explicit world state, an object texture memory keeps and adapts each object's appearance, and a generative renderer combines current structure with the remembered appearance.

title: Velox: Spatial Memory Makes World Models Efficient
tldr_zh: 免训练的注意力路由，把历史块表示为带深度区间的相机视锥切片，按与当前块的视锥重叠调制各层的块重要性，只读取相关区域的上下文，缓解KV缓存增长带来的生成变慢。
tldr_en: A training-free attention router that represents past blocks as camera frustum slabs with depth intervals and uses their overlap with the current block to reweight each layer's block importance, focusing attention on relevant regions to ease the slowdown as the KV cache grows.

title: Momentum: Persistent Dynamics for Video World Models
tldr_zh: 把演化中的场景表示为图中多组环视参考相机的同步视频，先联合生成这些视频作为场景动态的共享记忆，再让目标相机视频以其为条件，使离开视野的动态内容仍被表示并一致重现。
tldr_en: Represents an evolving scene as synchronized videos from a graph of surround-view reference camera rigs, generated jointly as a shared memory of scene dynamics, and grounds target-camera generation in that memory so moving content stays represented after leaving the view and reappears consistently.

title: UniState: Unifying Memory and Intervention for Controllable World Simulation
tldr_zh: 把空间记忆与用户干预统一为同一个世界状态表示，用户直接在空间记忆中指定物体运动、另选相机轨迹观察结果，使干预造成的场景变化在后续生成中保持。
tldr_en: Unifies spatial memory and user interventions in one world-state representation: users move objects directly inside the spatial memory and choose a separate camera path to observe the outcome, so intervention-induced scene changes persist across rollouts.

title: State World Models: Execute the Rules, Generate the Pixels
tldr_zh: 把世界演化与视频渲染分离，按规则维护并更新显式世界状态，将每轮动作结果编译成指令交给冻结的视频模型渲染，并构建反事实孪生对基准检验依赖隐藏状态的规则遵从。
tldr_en: Separates world evolution from rendering by keeping an explicit, rule-governed world state that a frozen video model renders turn by turn, and builds a benchmark of counterfactual twin pairs to test whether outcomes follow hidden state not visible in the frame.

title: ActionRoPE: action as coordinates for spatially consistent control in planar-camera game world models
tldr_zh: 面向俯视、等距等平面相机游戏，把动作引起的相机位移转为世界坐标下的旋转位置编码，使同一世界位置的token在不同时刻保持相同位置地址，并按已观测区域与新暴露区域分配逐token去噪调度。
tldr_en: For top-down and isometric games, converts action-driven camera displacement into world-coordinate rotary positions so tokens at the same world location keep the same positional address over time, and schedules denoising per token so already-observed regions settle before newly revealed ones.

title: Learning to Simulate Dynamic Environments With GameGAN
tldr_zh: 从游戏画面与键盘动作学习可交互的游戏模拟器，用记忆模块构建环境的内部地图，使回到已访问位置时画面保持一致，并解耦静态与动态成分。
tldr_en: Learns a playable game simulator from screen frames and keyboard actions, with a memory module that builds an internal map of the environment so revisited locations stay consistent, and separates static from dynamic components.

title: Temporally Consistent Transformers for Video Generation
tldr_zh: 针对内容出画后再回访时被重新编造的问题，构建迷宫、Minecraft和室内扫描三个长程依赖视频数据集，并提出把输入序列压缩为少量嵌入、经时间Transformer建模后由空间MaskGit展开的生成模型。
tldr_en: Addresses video models that invent new content when an out-of-view region is revisited, curating three long-range-dependency datasets from mazes, Minecraft, and indoor scans, and proposing a model that compresses inputs into fewer embeddings, runs a temporal transformer over them, and decodes with a spatial MaskGit.

title: SceneScape: Text-Driven Consistent Scene Generation
tldr_zh: 文本驱动的无尽视角生成，结合预训练文生图模型与单目深度，在线把生成帧融合进逐步构建的统一网格，并用测试时训练使当前深度与已合成的场景几何一致。
tldr_en: Text-driven perpetual view generation that pairs a pretrained text-to-image model with monocular depth, fusing each generated frame into a progressively built mesh and using test-time training to keep predicted depth consistent with the scene synthesized so far.

title: Reward Forcing: Efficient Streaming Video Generation with Rewarded Distribution Matching Distillation
tldr_zh: 针对流式视频生成过度依赖静态汇点token而复制首帧的问题，用指数滑动平均把滑出窗口的token持续融入固定大小的汇点token，并以视觉语言模型评定的运动奖励加权分布匹配蒸馏。
tldr_en: Streaming video generators that lean on static sink tokens tend to copy the first frame; this work keeps fixed-size sink tokens that absorb tokens leaving the sliding window through an exponential moving average, and weights distribution matching distillation by VLM-rated motion rewards.

title: OneStory: Coherent Multi-Shot Video Generation with Adaptive Memory
tldr_zh: 把多镜头视频生成改写为逐镜头的自回归生成，从先前镜头中挑选语义相关的信息帧构成全局记忆，再按重要性分块压缩为紧凑上下文作条件。
tldr_en: Recasts multi-shot video generation as next-shot generation, building a global memory from semantically relevant frames picked from earlier shots and compressing it into compact context through importance-guided patchification.

title: TinyHistory: Lightweight Video History Embeddings via Two-Stage Context Learning
tldr_zh: 为自回归视频扩散学习轻量的历史嵌入：先在大规模视频上以随机帧查询目标预训练历史编码器，再把它接入生成模型学习内容一致性，从而在有限显存内编码更长的历史。
tldr_en: Learns lightweight history embeddings for autoregressive video diffusion by pretraining a history encoder with a randomized frame-query objective and then plugging it into the generator to learn content-level consistency, so longer histories fit within a fixed memory budget.

title: PackCache: A Training-Free Acceleration Method for Unified Autoregressive Video Generation via Compact KV-Cache
tldr_zh: 统一自回归视频生成的免训练 KV cache 管理：保留文本与条件图像作语义锚点，按与当前帧的时间距离分配缓存预算，并在删除缓存后保持三维位置编码连贯。
tldr_en: Training-free KV-cache management for unified autoregressive video generation that keeps text and conditioning-image tokens as semantic anchors, allocates cache budget by temporal distance from the current frame, and keeps 3D position encodings coherent after tokens are removed.

title: VideoMemory: Toward Consistent Video Generation via Memory Integration
tldr_zh: 面向多镜头叙事视频的以实体为中心的框架，多智能体按剧本拆分镜头，从动态记忆库检索角色、道具和背景的视觉与语义描述作条件生成，并在每个镜头后更新记忆库；另构建多镜头一致性基准。
tldr_en: An entity-centric framework for multi-shot narrative video in which agents split a script into shots, condition generation on character, prop, and background descriptors retrieved from a dynamic memory bank, and update the bank after each shot; it also introduces a multi-shot consistency benchmark.

title: Past- and Future-Informed KV Cache Policy with Salience Estimation in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
tldr_zh: 针对自回归视频扩散中启发式KV cache策略忽视token重要性的问题，用从双向教师蒸馏的轻量显著性估计头为token打分，保留重要token并淘汰冗余token。
tldr_en: Replaces heuristic KV cache policies in autoregressive video diffusion with a lightweight salience head, distilled from a bidirectional teacher, that scores tokens so the cache keeps the informative ones and evicts the rest.

title: Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion and World Models with Temporal Cache Compression and Sparse Attention
tldr_zh: 自回归视频扩散与世界模型的免训练注意力框架：按帧间时间对应压缩 KV cache 以限制其增长，并用近似最近邻选取相关提示词与键，稀疏化交叉注意力和自注意力。
tldr_en: A training-free attention framework for autoregressive video diffusion and world models that compresses the KV cache via temporal correspondence to bound its growth, and uses approximate nearest-neighbor matching to sparsify cross- and self-attention.

title: Quant VideoGen: Auto-Regressive Long Video Generation via 2-Bit KV-Cache Quantization
tldr_zh: 针对自回归视频扩散中KV cache占满显存、限制有效工作记忆的问题，提出免训练的2比特KV cache量化：用语义感知平滑得到便于量化的残差，再以由粗到细的渐进残差量化降低误差。
tldr_en: Applies training-free 2-bit quantization to the KV cache of autoregressive video diffusion, whose growth exhausts GPU memory and limits effective working memory, using semantic-aware smoothing to produce quantization-friendly residuals and coarse-to-fine progressive residual quantization to reduce error.

title: Rolling Sink: Bridging Limited-Horizon Training and Open-Ended Testing in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
tldr_zh: 把超出训练时长后的退化归因于缓存内容与训练时不一致，提出免训练的推理时缓存策略：在固定预算内保留低漂移内容与少量近期上下文，并滑动时间索引、调度语义。
tldr_en: Attributes degradation beyond the training horizon to a mismatch between test-time and training-time cache contents, and proposes a training-free cache policy that, within a fixed budget, restores low-drift content, sliding temporal indices, and evolving semantics while keeping a small recent context.

title: Relax Forcing: Relaxed KV-Memory for Consistent Long Video Generation
tldr_zh: 分析自回归长视频推理中KV记忆的数量与时间位置对运动的影响，提出免训练的记忆结构：汇点帧提供全局稳定，尾部帧保持短期连贯，并按松弛准则挑选与全局锚点对齐、与近期内容不冗余的历史帧。
tldr_en: Studies how the amount and temporal placement of KV memory shape motion in long autoregressive rollouts, and proposes a training-free memory of sink frames for global stability, tail frames for short-term continuity, and history frames chosen by a relaxation criterion that favors alignment with global anchors and penalizes redundancy with recent context.

title: PackForcing: Short Video Training Suffices for Long Video Sampling and Long Context Inference
tldr_zh: 把自回归视频生成的历史KV分为三部分：全分辨率保留的汇点token、经双分支网络大幅压缩并按top-k动态选取的中段token、全分辨率的近期token，并用时间RoPE调整弥合丢弃token留下的位置间隔。
tldr_en: Splits the KV history of autoregressive video generation into full-resolution sink tokens, heavily compressed mid tokens picked by dynamic top-k selection, and full-resolution recent tokens, with a temporal RoPE adjustment that closes the position gaps left by dropped tokens.

title: Attend Locally, Remember Linearly: Linear Attention as Cross-Frame Memory for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
tldr_zh: 把预训练自回归视频扩散模型改为混合注意力：帧内保留softmax注意力，帧间用门控循环线性注意力维护固定大小的状态作为跨帧记忆，且只在去噪完成后更新状态。
tldr_en: Converts a pretrained autoregressive video diffusion model to hybrid attention, keeping softmax attention within each frame and replacing cross-frame attention with a gated recurrent linear branch whose fixed-size state acts as memory and is updated only after a frame is fully denoised.

title: SlotMemory: Object-Centric KV Memory for Streaming Long-Video Generation
tldr_zh: 流式视频扩散的以物体为中心的KV记忆，把键值空间分解为可复用的语义槽位，以槽位为地址存取高保真KV token，使实体在出画或提示切换后仍保持一致。
tldr_en: An object-centric KV memory for streaming video diffusion that decomposes the key-value space into reusable semantic slots and uses them as addresses to store and retrieve high-fidelity KV tokens, so entities stay consistent after leaving the frame or across prompt changes.

title: MASS: Multiplayer World Models with Authoritative Shared State
tldr_zh: 针对多人世界模型把世界状态与视角相关的视觉latent纠缠在一起的问题，由学习的逻辑引擎根据联合动作推进全局权威的类型化状态，作为唯一的循环记忆与同步基准，再由渲染引擎为任意相机生成视图。
tldr_en: Separates world dynamics from rendering in multiplayer world models: a learned logic engine advances a global, authoritative typed state from joint actions as the only recurrent memory and synchronization reference, and a learned rendering engine draws views for any requested camera.

title: Programmable World Model
tldr_zh: 将世界状态演化与画面生成解耦：智能体把自然语言指令转成规定实体状态和转移规则的程序，由轻量引擎维护包括画外实体在内的显式持久世界状态，再把状态表示为带属性的三维有向包围盒，连同相机轨迹编译为像素对齐的时空条件，交给预训练视频模型渲染；另构建CombatStateBench。
tldr_en: Decouples world-state evolution from rendering: an agent turns language instructions into programs that define entity states and transition rules, a lightweight engine maintains an explicit persistent world state that includes off-screen entities, and state-augmented 3D oriented bounding boxes are compiled into conditioning for a video model; the paper also introduces CombatStateBench.
